papers.relevance_reason_zh: 论文分析Muon与Adam优化器的谱特性并改进训练效率，属于模型训练优化，无关安全推理。
papers.title_zh: 谱分配：为什么Muon优于Adam，以及如何改进Muon
papers.abstract_zh: 诸如Muon之类的正交优化器相对于Adam可以大幅加速大型语言模型的预训练，但其机制仍未完全理解。我们通过对Transformer损失景观的样本外谱探查分析来研究这一问题。在真实训练轨迹的检查点上，我们将每个动量缓冲分解为奇异方向，并在保留数据上估计每个方向上的损失最优步长。由此产生的谱剖面是各向异性的，但在批次和训练阶段之间保持稳定，并且在优化器和模型规模之间保持一致：一个在稳定性边缘（Edge-of-Stability）运行的波动头部所支持的步长远小于容忍的主体（bulk）所支持的步长，后者允许明显更大的步长。该剖面为为什么Muon优于Adam、而Adam优于SGD提供了统一的谱分配解释。它还揭示了Muon均匀缩放的一个局限性：它仍未充分利用主体。在这一发现的指导下，我们引入了谱感知Muon（SAMuon），它将头部保持在Muon尺度，并使用静态谱先验放大主体。我们提供了两个变体：完整的SAMuon使用低秩随机SVD遵循测量的剖面，而简化的SAMuon-lite通过秩一幂迭代使用两级近似。在规模上，这两种方法都没有增加持久优化器状态，也没有在Muon之外增加显著的计算量（FLOPs），并且两者的理想化精确白化版本在标准假设下保留了Muon的渐近收敛率。在从124M到1B参数的“modded-nanogpt”模型中，两个变体在所有评估的模型规模和批大小配置下都优于调优的AdamW和Muon（Scion实现）基线。SAMuon达到与Muon相同的验证损失所需的训练token减少13.3%至24.0%，而SAMuon-lite以接近零的挂钟开销保留了大部分收益。

papers.title: CEDAR: Controlled and Event-Driven Demand Forecasting via Residual Decomposition
papers.abstract: Forecasting in large-scale e-commerce marketplaces is increasingly required to support planning: merchants need to evaluate sales outcomes under future action sequences such as budget schedules, rather than passively predicting what happens next. However, most existing time series forecasting (TSF) approaches remain inherently passive. Even when incorporating operational decisions as auxiliary covariates, they typically optimize for correlation-based extrapolation under historical policies. This design suffers from autoregressive inertia and conflates endogenous market evolution with decision-induced transitions, leading to policy-insensitive rollouts and unreliable counterfactual analysis. To bridge this gap, we propose CEDAR (Controlled and Event-Driven Demand forecasting via Action-aware Residual decomposition), a two-stage framework for robust decision-conditioned simulation. In Stage I, an Action-Interleaved Transformer learns controllable action-conditioned state transitions for rollout under planned interventions. In Stage II, a Residual Correction Module leverages external event signals and LLM-assisted text representations to align noisy event descriptions with product context and correct event-driven deviations. Our study is enabled by a large-scale real-world dataset from Alibaba 1688, comprising approximately 32 million product trajectories with paired state-action sequences and aligned event signals. Extensive offline experiments and online controlled experiments in production demonstrate that CEDAR consistently improves simulation accuracy over strong TSF baselines and delivers practical gains for real-world budget planning.

papers.title_zh: CEDAR：基于残差分解的受控与事件驱动需求预测
papers.abstract_zh: 大规模电子商务市场中的预测日益需要支持规划：商家需要评估未来行动序列（如预算安排）下的销售结果，而不是被动地预测接下来会发生什么。然而，大多数现有时间序列预测（TSF）方法本质上仍然是被动的。即使将运营决策作为辅助协变量纳入，它们通常也在历史策略下优化基于相关性的外推。这种设计存在自回归惯性，并将内生市场演化与决策引发的转变混为一谈，导致对策略不敏感的推演和不可靠的反事实分析。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了CEDAR（通过行动感知残差分解进行受控和事件驱动的需求预测），这是一个用于稳健决策条件模拟的两阶段框架。在第一阶段，行动交织Transformer学习可控的、以行动为条件的状态转换，以在计划干预下进行推演。在第二阶段，残差校正模块利用外部事件信号和LLM辅助的文本表示，将嘈杂的事件描述与产品上下文对齐，并纠正事件驱动的偏差。我们的研究得益于来自阿里巴巴1688的大规模真实世界数据集，包含约3200万条产品轨迹，配有状态-行动序列对和对齐的事件信号。在生产环境中进行的大量离线实验和在线受控实验表明，CEDAR在强TSF基线上持续提高了模拟准确性，并为现实世界的预算规划带来了实际收益。

papers.title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Aggregation in Semi-Supervised Federated Learning with non-IID Data
papers.abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables distributed training of machine learning models while preserving data privacy. However, FL struggles with heterogeneous, non-IID client data distributions, resulting in sub-optimal and biased global models. In this paper, we propose pFedMARL, a novel approach leveraging Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) with Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3) to dynamically adapt aggregation strategies in FL settings. Our method employs a server-side agent adjusting client contributions to optimize global model robustness and client-side agents balancing global and local updates to personalize models effectively without pre-training. We demonstrate superior performance of pFedMARL for training a semi-supervised audio spectrogram transformer, matching or outperforming FedAvg, Ditto, and local training approaches across multiple non-IID scenarios and in the presence of adversarial clients. Our results indicate that pFedMARL actively improves accuracy, robustness, and fairness, making it suitable for real-world deployments.

papers.summary_zh:
## 一句话结论

本文提出 **pFedMARL**，利用多智能体强化学习（Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning, MARL）动态调整联邦学习的聚合策略，在半监督音频 Transformer 任务上匹配或超越 FedAvg、Ditto 和本地训练方法。

## 问题与动机

联邦学习（Federated Learning, FL）能在不共享原始数据的前提下进行分布式模型训练，从而保护数据隐私。然而，当客户端数据呈 **non-IID**（非独立同分布）时，传统 FL 训练的全局模型容易次优且有偏。固定或启发式的聚合权重难以适应异构数据分布，因此需要一种能动态调整客户端贡献的自适应聚合机制。

## 方法与技术路线

pFedMARL 将聚合策略建模为多智能体协作问题，在 FL 训练过程中引入两类智能体：

- **服务端智能体**：负责调整各客户端的贡献权重（即聚合系数），目标是优化全局模型的鲁棒性；
- **客户端智能体**：负责在全局更新与本地更新之间做平衡，从而实现有效的个性化模型，且无需预训练。

这些智能体采用 **TD3**（Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient，双延迟深度确定性策略梯度）算法进行训练。摘要未说明智能体的具体状态空间、动作空间、奖励函数设计，也未说明 TD3 网络结构或训练超参数。

实验设定为：训练一个**半监督音频频谱图 Transformer** 模型。比较对象包括 **FedAvg**（联邦平均）、**Ditto**（一种个性化 FL 方法）以及**本地训练**。评测覆盖多个 non-IID 场景，并引入**对抗客户端**（adversarial clients）来测试鲁棒性。摘要未披露数据集来源、non-IID 划分方式、对抗行为的具体定义或实验轮数等细节。

## 主要结果

pFedMARL 在这些场景中匹配或优于 FedAvg、Ditto 和本地训练方法。摘要指出该方法能主动提升**准确性、鲁棒性和公平性**，因此适合真实世界部署。

## 为什么与兴趣相关

联邦学习的核心难点之一是在保护隐私与提升模型泛化之间取得平衡。pFedMARL 将聚合策略从静态规则变为强化学习驱动的动态决策，为异构数据下的分布式训练提供了新思路。虽然本文不涉及具体密码学安全推理协议，但其“服务端-客户端协同”的优化机制对隐私保护场景下的模型聚合、公平性与抗攻击能力研究具有参考价值。

papers.title: LocalLSTC: A Long Short-Term Control Architecture for Locally Deployed GUI Agents
papers.abstract: Modern GUI-agent frameworks achieve strong desktop task performance with frontier API models, yet persistent control information often remains implicit in growing interaction trajectories. At each step, the planner reconstructs the active task stage, accumulated evidence, and runtime feedback before deciding the next action. This dependence becomes more pronounced under weaker local reasoning backbones. Across four representative state-of-the-art frameworks, replacing GPT-5 with Qwen3.5-9B reduces average OSWorld SR-100 from 60.9\% to 37.7\%. Trajectory annotation further identifies at least one control failure in 91.6\% of failed trajectories. To address this problem, we introduce LocalLSTC, a training-free architecture that organizes control by temporal scope, maintaining persistent cross-step state to guide short-term execution commitments. Long-Term Control maintains the active subgoal, subgoal-aligned evidence, and runtime feedback across interactions, while Short-Term Execution realizes bounded commitments for the current step. Long-to-Short Planning forms each commitment from persistent state, and Short-to-Long Control integrates execution outcomes back into that state for progress assessment, recovery, and termination. With Qwen3.6-27B, LocalLSTC reaches 64.7\% SR-100 on OSWorld and 65.3\% on WindowsAgentArena, outperforming the strongest prior local results on both benchmarks. Ablations further support contributions from mechanisms on both sides of execution. These findings identify temporal organization of control information as a distinct architectural dimension for locally deployed GUI agents.

papers.title_zh: LocalLSTC：一种用于本地部署GUI智能体的长短期控制架构
papers.abstract_zh: 现代GUI智能体框架借助前沿API模型在桌面任务上取得了强劲表现，但持续的控制信息在日益增长的交互相轨中往往仍是隐式的。在每一步，规划器需先重建当前任务阶段、累积证据和运行时反馈，然后才决定下一步动作。在较弱的本地推理骨干下，这种依赖性变得更加明显。在四个具有代表性的最新框架中，将GPT-5替换为Qwen3.5-9B会使OSWorld SR-100的平均值从60.9%降至37.7%。轨迹标注进一步表明，91.6%的失败轨迹中至少存在一次控制失败。为解决这一问题，我们提出了LocalLSTC，一种无需训练的架构，按时间范围组织控制，维护跨步骤的持久状态以指导短期执行承诺。长期控制维护跨交互的当前子目标、与子目标一致的证据和运行时反馈，而短期执行则实现当前步骤的有界承诺。长到短规划从持久状态形成每个承诺，而短到长控制将执行结果整合回该状态，用于进度评估、恢复和终止。使用Qwen3.6-27B，LocalLSTC在OSWorld上达到64.7%的SR-100，在WindowsAgentArena上达到65.3%，在两项基准上都优于此前最强的本地结果。消融研究进一步支持执行两侧机制的贡献。这些发现将控制信息的时间组织确立为本地部署GUI智能体的一个独立架构维度。

papers.title: EXAONE Tabular 1.0 : Technical Report
papers.abstract: EXAONE Tabular is a compact tabular foundation model family for classification and regression via in-context learning, producing predictions without dataset-specific gradient updates. Pretrained exclusively on a synthetic structural-causal-model (SCM) prior, its central contribution is an architecture-centered redesign of tabular in-context learning. Rather than compressing features into a fixed row embedding before a separate row-level learner, EXAONE Tabular interleaves feature-axis attention within each item with support-conditioned item-axis attention within each feature at every Transformer layer, mediated by item-summary and feature-summary tokens. Across four public benchmarks, EXAONE Tabular combines strong predictive performance with high efficiency. On TabArena, its 20.81M-parameter classification model ranks first overall, surpassing tuned ensembles and 4-hour AutoML pipelines, while regression reaches the performance regime of the 1.64B-parameter TabFM at roughly 1/11 the inference cost. On BCCO and TALENT, EXAONE Tabular ranks second in classification and first in regression. On ScoringBench, it achieves the best mean rank for both point-estimation and predictive-distribution quality, leading the $R^2$, RMSE, and CRPS evaluations. Together, these results establish EXAONE Tabular as a state-of-the-art compact tabular foundation model family, combining strong predictive performance across classification, point regression, and probabilistic regression with an efficient model design.

papers.title_zh: EXAONE Tabular 1.0：技术报告
papers.abstract_zh: EXAONE Tabular是一个紧凑型表格基础模型系列，通过上下文学习进行分类和回归，无需针对特定数据集的梯度更新即可产生预测。其仅使用合成结构因果模型（SCM）先验进行预训练，核心贡献在于对表格上下文学习进行以架构为中心的重新设计。EXAONE Tabular并非在独立的行级学习器之前将特征压缩为固定的行嵌入，而是在每个Transformer层中，将每个项内的特征轴注意力与每个特征内由支持集条件化的项轴注意力交错进行，并通过项摘要和特征摘要token进行中介。在四个公开基准上，EXAONE Tabular兼具强大的预测性能和高效率。在TabArena上，其20.81M参数分类模型总体排名第一，超越了调优后的集成模型和4小时AutoML流水线，而回归则以约1/11的推理成本达到了1.64B参数TabFM的性能水平。在BCCO和TALENT上，EXAONE Tabular分类排名第二、回归排名第一。在ScoringBench上，它在点估计和预测分布质量两方面均取得最佳平均排名，在R²、RMSE和CRPS评估中领先。综上，这些结果确立了EXAONE Tabular作为最先进的紧凑型表格基础模型系列的地位，将分类、点回归和概率回归方面的强预测性能与高效的模型设计相结合。

papers.title: MeMark: Membrane-Space Watermarking for Spiking Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) are increasingly distributed as pretrained checkpoints and reused as backbones for new tasks. However, current SNN watermarks are mainly verified against the model output. Thus, a user who replaces the output head can keep most of the original network while removing the evidence used for verification. We present MeMark, a watermark designed for the checkpoint-reuse setting. Instead of storing the watermark in the output head, MeMark embeds a multi-bit identifier in the internal membrane state of selected Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neurons. A secret input drives each selected neuron to the chosen side of its own firing threshold, and the same threshold is later used to recover the secret bit, so the verifier does not need a learned decoder. We evaluate MeMark across recurrent, convolutional, residual, and transformer SNNs. On a 215.4M-parameter SpikeGPT checkpoint, all 20 independent 64-bit keys pass the fixed 51/64 verification rule, while none of the $30\,000$ fresh random keys pass when tested against all 20 protected checkpoints and the clean model. All 20 genuine keys also remain above the threshold after fine-tuning, 90\% pruning, int8 quantization, and output-head replacement. Under our stated threat model, adaptive attacks can weaken the watermark but do not remove the ownership evidence in the settings we test. Additionally, we study false ownership claims, key-aware and key-agnostic removal, partial key disclosure, rollback, and extraction into a student. The results show that MeMark can provide evidence of checkpoint derivatives, while being resistant to the adversary's attacks and complete head replacement.

papers.title_zh: MeMark：脉冲神经网络的膜空间水印
papers.abstract_zh: 脉冲神经网络（SNNs）越来越多地以预训练检查点的形式分发，并作为新任务的主干网络被复用。然而，当前的SNN水印主要针对模型输出进行验证。因此，替换输出头的用户可以在保留大部分原始网络的同时移除用于验证的证据。我们提出MeMark，一种为检查点复用场景设计的水印。MeMark不是将水印存储在输出头中，而是将多位标识符嵌入所选漏电积分发放（LIF）神经元的内部膜状态。一个秘密输入驱动每个选定神经元到达其自身放电阈值的选定一侧，之后使用同一阈值恢复秘密比特，因此验证者不需要学习得到的解码器。我们在循环、卷积、残差和Transformer SNN上评估了MeMark。在一个215.4M参数的SpikeGPT检查点上，所有20个独立的64位密钥都通过固定的51/64验证规则，而在针对所有20个受保护检查点和干净模型进行测试时，30000个全新的随机密钥没有一个通过。所有20个真实密钥在微调、90%剪枝、int8量化和输出头替换后仍保持在阈值之上。在我们所述的威胁模型下，自适应攻击可以削弱水印，但在我们测试的设置中并不能移除所有权证据。此外，我们研究了虚假所有权声明、密钥相关与密钥无关的移除、部分密钥泄露、回滚以及提取到学生模型。结果表明，MeMark既能提供检查点衍生模型的证据，又能抵抗对手的攻击和完全输出头替换。

papers.title: LMSM: LLM Security Framework Inspired by Linux Security Modules
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed with layered defenses, yet malicious prompts can still bypass them. Interpretability methods can expose model-internal signals along the generation path that could inform enforcement, but these signals are not security controls by themselves. Deployments that adapt them for safety typically couple each signal to its own calibration, policy logic, and intervention code, so each new artifact creates integration work instead of strengthening a shared defense. We present Language Model Security Modules (LMSM), a security framework that adapts the separation behind Linux Security Modules (LSM) to LLM serving. In LMSM, a selected security backend exposes calibrated evidence, a versioned policy evaluates active rules over trusted per-request context, and a separate gate authorizes buffered output release. This design separates mediation correctness from policy effectiveness, and it allows backend, rule, or schedule changes without rebuilding request handling or enforcement. papers.summary_zh:
## 一句话结论

LMSM 借鉴 Linux Security Modules (LSM) 的分离设计，为大语言模型（LLM）服务提出一个统一安全框架，使模型内部可解释性信号可以转化为运行时强制执行的共享防御。

## 问题与动机

LLM 服务普遍采用分层防御，但恶意提示仍能绕过。可解释性方法能沿生成路径暴露模型内部信号，本可用于安全执行，但这些信号本身不是安全控制。现有部署通常把每个信号与自身的校准、策略逻辑和干预代码耦合，新增一个可解释性构件就要重新做集成，难以累积成共享防线。

## 方法与技术路线

LMSM 处理的输入是各用户请求及与之绑定的可信每请求上下文，输出是经门控授权后释放的缓冲生成结果。其核心思路是借鉴 LSM 将“调解正确性”与“策略有效性”分离：

- 一个被选中的**安全后端（security backend）** 暴露校准证据（calibrated evidence）；
- 一个**带版本策略（versioned policy）** 基于可信的每请求上下文评估活动规则；
- 一个独立**门控（gate）** 授权缓冲输出的释放。

三者各司其职，后端、规则或调度变更都无需重建请求处理或强制逻辑。这样可解释性信号就能作为“证据”接入统一安全机制，而不是为每个新构件单独开发校准、策略和干预代码。

原型基于 Hugging Face Transformers 与连续批处理 vLLM 实现，同一底层环境可承载 artifact-backed 稀疏自编码器（SAE）和 transcoder 部署，以及任务适配的密集探针（dense probes）；在调度抖动下保持每个请求的决策独立性，并能按请求选择性执行和组合多条规则。摘要未说明策略规则的具体形式、安全后端的校准步骤、门控的判定细节以及实验数据集设置。

## 主要结果

在 Qwen3-4B 上，LMSM-Checkpoint 将 HarmBench 攻击成功率从 39.20% 降至 3.32%，XSTest 误拒从 2.40% 升至 4.40%；在 32 条活跃序列下，相比不做监控的匹配服务路径，保留了 98.14% 的吞吐量。

## 为什么与兴趣相关

LMSM 给可解释性研究提供了一个统一的运行时强制出口，让模型内部分析成果不必重复“校准-策略-干预”的定制集成，而是能直接服务于恶意提示拦截。这有助于构建可扩展、可组合的 LLM 安全防线，是连接可解释性与实际安全部署的重要尝试。

papers.title: LDAC-Net: A Learnable Multi-Lag Differencing Attention-Convolution Network for Drift-Robust Recognition with Low-Cost MOX Gas Sensors
papers.abstract: Portable electronic-nose systems based on low-cost metal-oxide (MOX) gas sensors offer a practical solution for gas and odour recognition, but their signals are affected by slow chemical transients, drifting sensor offsets, scale variation, and cross-channel correlations. Existing pipelines commonly use fixed first-order temporal differencing (FOTD), which requires a manually selected lag and may discard useful response information. We propose LDAC-Net, an end-to-end learnable multi-lag differencing attention-convolution network that operates directly on multi-channel MOX signals. Its learnable differential feature enhancement front-end combines window-conditioned statistical affine normalisation, which compensates for window-specific offset and scale variation, with learnable multi-lag differencing, which weights and combines temporal differences across multiple lags. A compact attention-convolution backbone subsequently models local transients and longer-range temporal dependencies. On the 50-class SmellNet-Base task, LDAC-Net achieves 68.2% top-1 accuracy, exceeding the best FOTD-preprocessed comparison model by approximately 14 percentage points and the raw-input Transformer by more than 30 points. Ablation studies confirm the contributions of both proposed components. The representation also transfers to SmellNet-Mixtures, improving accuracy from 45.4% to 50.5%, and generalises to the 62-channel eNose-Drift benchmark under strong long-term drift, achieving 70.6% top-1 accuracy and 69.6% macro-F1. These results outperform the best comparison model with dataset-retuned FOTD preprocessing by 8.0 and 3.0 points, respectively, demonstrating that learnable, sensor-aware preprocessing is more effective than fixed handcrafted differencing for low-cost MOX gas-sensor recognition.

papers.title_zh: LDAC-Net: 一种用于低成本MOX气体传感器漂移鲁棒识别的可学习多滞后差分注意力-卷积网络
papers.abstract_zh: 基于低成本金属氧化物（MOX）气体传感器的便携式电子鼻系统为气体和气味识别提供了实用解决方案，但其信号受到缓慢化学瞬态、传感器偏移漂移、尺度变化和跨通道相关性的影响。现有流程通常使用固定的一阶时间差分（FOTD），这需要手动选择滞后，并可能丢弃有用的响应信息。我们提出了LDAC-Net，一种端到端的可学习多滞后差分注意力-卷积网络，直接对多通道MOX信号进行操作。其可学习差分特征增强前端将窗口条件统计仿射归一化（补偿窗口特定的偏移和尺度变化）与可学习多滞后差分（加权并组合多个滞后上的时间差分）相结合。紧凑的注意力-卷积骨干网络随后对局部瞬态和更长范围的时间依赖性进行建模。在50类SmellNet-Base任务上，LDAC-Net实现了68.2%的top-1准确率，超过最佳FOTD预处理对比模型约14个百分点，超过原始输入Transformer 30多个百分点。消融研究证实了所提出两个组件的贡献。该表示还迁移到SmellNet-Mixtures，将准确率从45.4%提高到50.5%，并在强长期漂移下泛化到62通道eNose-Drift基准，实现了70.6%的top-1准确率和69.6%的宏F1。这些结果分别超过使用数据集重新调优FOTD预处理的最佳对比模型8.0和3.0个百分点，表明对于低成本MOX气体传感器识别，可学习的、感知传感器的预处理比固定的手工差分更有效。

papers.title: A Dual-Transformer for Multi-Camera View Recommendation
papers.abstract: Multi-camera systems are foundational to modern media production, and multi-camera editing is a critical task. This involves the proper selection of the appropriate camera view at each moment. In this paper, we propose a novel Dual-Transformer architecture with Cross-Attention that heavily outperformed the current SOTA models over the TVMCE dataset (TV Shows Multicamera Editing dataset). Our model decouples these tasks: (1) a dedicated temporal encoder first processes the sequence of past frames to build a rich memory of the recent history, and (2) the candidate camera views then act as queries to this memory via a cross-attention module, allowing each candidate to independently interrogate the historical context and find the most relevant information for its own evaluation. Our approach achieved 56.60% Precision@0.5, representing a substantial improvement over the prior best result of 37.16%. We further conducted an ablation study exploring the use of lightweight backbone architectures, where the SwinV2 backbone yielded the best performance, achieving 69.65% Precision@0.5. Using this best-performing configuration, we then investigated the feasibility of adapting the model to replicate the editing style of a specific human editor. To this end, we fine-tuned the model using varying proportions of the initial segment of a target video. Our results demonstrate that even with only 20% of the video used for fine-tuning, the model exhibited measurable improvements in Precision@0.5, indicating strong potential for data-efficient personalization of editing style adapted to each individual TV show or producer.

papers.title_zh: 一种用于多摄像机视角推荐的双Transformer模型
papers.abstract_zh: 多摄像机系统是现代媒体制作的基础，而多摄像机剪辑是一项关键任务。这涉及到在每个时刻正确选择合适的摄像机视角。在本文中，我们提出了一种带有交叉注意力机制的新型Dual-Transformer架构，其在TVMCE数据集（TV Shows Multicamera Editing dataset，即电视节目多摄像机剪辑数据集）上大幅超越了当前的SOTA模型。我们的模型将这些任务解耦：(1) 专门的时序编码器首先处理过去帧的序列，以构建对最近历史的丰富记忆；(2) 然后候选摄像机视角通过交叉注意力模块作为查询作用于该记忆，使每个候选能够独立查询历史上下文，并找到与其自身评估最相关的信息。我们的方法达到了56.60%的Precision@0.5，相比先前最佳结果37.16%有显著提升。我们进一步进行了消融研究，探索了轻量级骨干架构的使用，其中SwinV2骨干取得了最佳性能，达到了69.65%的Precision@0.5。使用这一性能最佳的配置，我们随后研究了将模型适配为复制特定人工剪辑师剪辑风格的可行性。为此，我们使用目标视频初始片段的不同比例对模型进行了微调。我们的结果表明，即使仅使用视频的20%进行微调，模型在Precision@0.5上也表现出可测量的提升，这表明在针对每个电视节目或制作人定制剪辑风格时，具有数据高效个性化的强大潜力。

papers.title: JIT-Agent: Scaling Harness Intelligence via Just-in-Time Harness Evolution
papers.abstract: Agent capability is not determined by the model alone. The agent harness, encompassing memory management, planning strategy, action protocol, and tool/skill orchestration, can dominate the contribution of the underlying foundation model. Yet harness design remains manual, task-specific, and fundamentally unscalable. We present JIT-Agent, a harness intelligence model trained to synthesize task-adaptive agent harnesses on the fly for arbitrary off-the-shelf agentic LLMs. We formalize the agent harness as a composable, machine-generatable artifact governed by a fixed four-module protocol, and train JIT-Agent to customize harnesses for a given task at hand, repair harnesses for stable and reliable execution, and self-evolve by distilling performance signals from an expanding archive of prior harness configurations. Equipped with JIT-Agent as a harness helper, DeepSeek-V4-Flash surpasses GPT-5.6 on DeepSearchQA (+9.1) and OdysseyBench (+4.3), while the already strong GLM-5.2 gains up to +20.2 points. Across controlled evaluations, JIT-Agent-generated harnesses are performance-competitive with mature agent runtimes such as OpenCode and Claude Code and consistently improve multi-scale model families of DeepSeek V4, Mimo-V2.5, and Qwen3.6. To our knowledge, JIT-Agent is the first model purpose-built for just-in-time harness generation, establishing harness intelligence as a trainable, transferable, and compounding dimension of agent capability orthogonal to model scaling.

papers.title_zh: JIT-Agent：通过即时智能体框架演化扩展智能体框架智能
papers.abstract_zh: 智能体能力并非仅由模型决定。智能体框架（agent harness）涵盖记忆管理、规划策略、动作协议以及工具/技能编排，可能主导底层基础模型的贡献。然而，智能体框架的设计仍然是手动的、特定于任务的，并且从根本上不可扩展。我们提出JIT-Agent，一个智能体框架智能模型，经过训练可以即时为任意现成的智能体LLM合成任务自适应的智能体框架。我们将智能体框架形式化为一个可组合、机器可生成的工件，由固定的四模块协议控制，并训练JIT-Agent为手头给定任务定制框架、修复框架以实现稳定可靠的执行，并通过从先前框架配置的不断扩展的档案中提取性能信号进行自我进化。以JIT-Agent作为框架助手，DeepSeek-V4-Flash在DeepSearchQA上超越GPT-5.6（+9.1），在OdysseyBench上超越GPT-5.6（+4.3），而本已强大的GLM-5.2则获得高达+20.2分的提升。在受控评估中，JIT-Agent生成的框架与成熟的智能体运行时（如OpenCode和Claude Code）在性能上具有竞争力，并持续改进DeepSeek V4、Mimo-V2.5和Qwen3.6等多尺度模型家族。据我们所知，JIT-Agent是首个专为即时框架生成而构建的模型，将框架智能确立为一个可训练、可迁移且可复合的智能体能力维度，与模型扩展正交。

papers.title: Virgil: Navigating Explainability for Transformer-based Language Models
papers.abstract: Explainability for transformer-based language models is becoming crucial as these systems are deployed in high-stakes applications. As a result, the ecosystem of explainability tools is rapidly evolving, becoming richer, but also more fragmented and harder to navigate. To address this challenge, we present Virgil, an interactive system that lets practitioners and researchers, including non-experts, navigate explainability tools for transformer language models. Supported by a curated knowledge base, the system enables users to discover and compare explainability tools within a unified interface.

papers.title_zh: Virgil：为基于Transformer的语言模型导航可解释性
papers.abstract_zh: 随着基于Transformer的语言模型被部署在高风险应用中，其可解释性正变得至关重要。因此，可解释性工具的生态系统正在迅速发展，变得更为丰富，但也更加碎片化，更难驾驭。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了Virgil，一个交互式系统，让从业者和研究人员（包括非专家）能够为Transformer语言模型导航可解释性工具。在精心整理的知识库支持下，该系统使用户能够在统一界面中发现和比较可解释性工具。

papers.title: Automatic weld seam segmentation for industrial quality control: a comparison of RGB and polarimetric imaging with CNN and transformer architectures
papers.abstract: Visual inspection of welded assemblies remains one of the least automated stages in many industrial production processes, still depending largely on the experience of human operators and thus subject to inter-operator variability; the manufacturing of special-purpose machinery cabins, the setting of this study, is one representative case. This work evaluates the feasibility of automatic weld seam segmentation from RGB and polarimetric imagery, comparing controlled laboratory acquisitions with images captured under real, uncontrolled conditions. Convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures and transformer-based architectures are benchmarked under a unified, threshold-independent protocol, training each CNN with three random seeds to separate genuine effects from seed noise. In controlled RGB conditions, CNN models reach a mean mask mAP50 of up to 0.87, but drop to 0.22-0.48 under uncontrolled acquisition, showing that the acquisition setup is a first-order component of the inspection system. Polarimetric imaging with alignment-preserving geometric augmentation localizes previously unseen welds with a mean mask mAP50 up to 0.93: on par with, rather than ahead of, the best controlled-RGB result, but reaching that accuracy on uncontrolled RGB without requiring acquisition control. The clearest architectural finding concerns viewpoint robustness. In-distribution, transformers and CNNs are broadly comparable; but under a test-time viewpoint shift, the transformer models, and RF-DETR in particular, retain high accuracy while every CNN collapses. The gap holds across three seeds and a resolution-matched control, pointing to architecture rather than training resolution. Within the CNN family, capacity brings no reliable in-distribution gain once seed variance is accounted for: small CNNs suffice for fixed viewpoints, transformers for variable ones.

papers.title_zh: 用于工业质量控制的自动焊缝分割：RGB与偏振成像结合CNN和Transformer架构的比较
papers.abstract_zh: 焊接组件的视觉检测仍是许多工业生产过程中自动化程度最低的环节之一，在很大程度上仍依赖人工操作员的经验，因此存在操作员间变异性；本研究所在的专用机械舱体制造便是典型一例。本工作评估了从RGB和偏振图像中进行自动焊缝分割的可行性，并将受控实验室采集与真实非受控条件下捕获的图像进行了比较。在统一的、与阈值无关的协议下，对卷积神经网络（CNN）架构和基于Transformer的架构进行了基准测试，并使用三个随机种子训练每个CNN，以区分真实效应与种子噪声。在受控RGB条件下，CNN模型的平均掩膜mAP50最高可达0.87，但在非受控采集下降至0.22-0.48，这表明采集设置是检测系统的首要组成部分。采用保持对齐的几何增强的偏振成像，能以最高达0.93的平均掩膜mAP50定位以前未见过的焊缝：这一结果与最佳受控RGB结果持平，而非超越，但它在非受控RGB条件下达到该精度，且无需采集控制。最清晰的架构发现涉及视角鲁棒性。在分布内，Transformer和CNN大致相当；但在测试时的视角偏移下，Transformer模型——尤其是RF-DETR——保持高精度，而所有CNN均崩溃。这一差距在三个种子和分辨率匹配的控制实验中均成立，表明差异源于架构而非训练分辨率。在CNN家族内部，一旦考虑种子方差，容量并不能带来可靠的分布内增益：小型CNN足以应对固定视角，而Transformer则适用于可变视角。

papers.title: Token-Oriented Semantic Communication with Pretrained Vision Transformers
papers.abstract: Token communications realize the semantic communication principle at the granularity of transformer tokens, providing a promising direction for client--server collaborative inference in resource-constrained edge systems. However, directly transmitting token embeddings presents two practical challenges: substantial communication cost and limited interoperability across model-specific token embedding spaces. To address these challenges, we propose a \emph{token-oriented} semantic communication framework. In this framework, token-level task relevance determines which compressed image latents are transmitted, enabling token-granular transmission without directly transmitting token embeddings. The framework is modular, coordinating three pretrained components---a lightweight client-side vision transformer (ViT), a learned image compression (LIC) model, and a large server-side ViT---without end-to-end training. The key enabler is the one-to-one spatial alignment between ViT patch tokens and the LIC latent vectors, which allows token-level task relevance to directly determine which latent vectors are transmitted. Building on this alignment, token-aligned LIC selectively transmits task-relevant latents, layer-selective attention rollout estimates token relevance from a selected range of attention layers in a single forward pass, and surrogate token substitution adapts the frozen server model by optimizing a single learnable token. Experiments on ImageNet show that the proposed framework achieves a more favorable rate--accuracy trade-off than recent semantic communication schemes, hand-crafted codecs, and task-agnostic LIC models.

papers.title_zh: 面向Token的语义通信与预训练视觉Transformer
papers.abstract_zh: Token通信在Transformer token粒度上实现了语义通信原理，为资源受限边缘系统中的客户端-服务器协同推理提供了一个有前途的方向。然而，直接传输token嵌入带来了两个实际挑战：大量通信成本和跨模型特定token嵌入空间的有限互操作性。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种面向token的语义通信框架。在该框架中，token级任务相关性决定传输哪些压缩图像潜变量，从而在不直接传输token嵌入的情况下实现token粒度传输。该框架是模块化的，协调了三个预训练组件——一个轻量级客户端视觉Transformer（ViT）、一个学习型图像压缩（LIC）模型和一个大型服务器端ViT——而无需端到端训练。关键使能因素是ViT patch token与LIC潜变量之间的一对一空间对齐，这允许token级任务相关性直接决定传输哪些潜变量。基于这一对齐，token对齐的LIC选择性地传输任务相关的潜变量；层选择性注意力展开在单次前向传播中从选定的注意力层范围估计token相关性；替代token替换通过优化单个可学习token来适应冻结的服务器模型。在ImageNet上的实验表明，所提出的框架比近期的语义通信方案、手工设计的编解码器和任务无关的LIC模型取得了更有利的率-准确率权衡。

papers.title: Adaptive Triggering for Bias Correction in LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract: Chain-of-thought prompting can expose and amplify demographic stereotypes within an LLM's intermediate reasoning and create a failure mode that final-answer debiasing alone cannot address. Mitigating such bias during generation presents a fundamental timing problem: intervening too late allows biased reasoning to propagate, while unnecessarily intervening can disrupt otherwise correct reasoning. Existing approaches largely avoid this decision by either evaluating completed reasoning chains post hoc or intervening at predetermined steps, leaving open when a developing reasoning trajectory provides sufficient evidence to warrant correction. We formulate this decision as an online change-point detection problem. A per-step bias signal updates a CUSUM statistic and a targeted correction is injected only when accumulated evidence crosses a detector-specific threshold calibrated on held-out data. We instantiate the framework with a white-box signal derived from next-token probabilities and a black-box signal obtained from an LLM judge, enabling deployment with both open-weight and hosted models. On gpt-4o-mini adaptive black-box triggering recovers most of the disambiguated-context accuracy lost under fixed-interval intervention while requiring substantially fewer interventions. That result holds even with an independent judge. Across six open-weight models, the white-box signal improves ambiguous-item accuracy on all six but reduces disambiguated-item accuracy on five because it cannot distinguish unsupported stereotype reliance from correct, stereotype-congruent evidence.

papers.title_zh: LLM推理中偏差校正的自适应触发
papers.abstract_zh: 思维链提示可以暴露并放大LLM中间推理中的人口统计学刻板印象，并产生一种仅靠最终答案去偏无法解决的失败模式。在生成过程中缓解此类偏差带来一个基本的时机问题：干预太晚会让有偏推理传播，而不必要的干预则会干扰原本正确的推理。现有方法大多回避了这一决策，要么事后评估已完成推理链，要么在预定步骤进行干预，从而留下一个问题：发展中的推理轨迹何时提供足够证据以支持纠正。我们将这一决策形式化为在线变点检测问题。每步偏差信号更新CUSUM统计量，且仅当累积证据跨过在保留数据上校准的检测器特定阈值时，才注入有针对性的纠正。我们用从下一个词元概率导出的白盒信号和从LLM评判器获得的黑盒信号实例化该框架，从而支持在开放权重模型和托管模型上进行部署。在gpt-4o-mini上，自适应黑盒触发恢复了在固定间隔干预下损失的大部分消歧上下文准确率，同时所需的干预次数大幅减少。即使使用独立的评判器，该结果仍然成立。在六个开放权重模型上，白盒信号在所有六个模型上提高了模糊项准确率，但在五个模型上降低了消歧项准确率，因为它无法区分无根据的刻板印象依赖与正确的、与刻板印象一致的证据。

papers.title: BixBench3: Benchmarking AI agents on research-study-scale computational biology tasks
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) promises to accelerate biological research by automating computational analyses. Yet the ability of AI agents to carry out computational biology at the scale of complete research studies has not been systematically evaluated. Here we introduce BixBench3, a benchmark that measures the capacity of AI agents to process raw biological data through to scientific results. We designed BixBench3 tasks to mirror the delegation of work from a scientist to an agent: the scientist chooses the research question and high-level methods, then delegates implementation of all analyses to the agent. In each task, an agent receives a research objective, methodological guidance, and raw data derived from a published scientific study, and must execute a sequence of analyses to achieve the research objective. The data artifacts resulting from these analyses - such as peak call matrices or differential expression tables - are programmatically graded against the corresponding artifacts generated and reported in the original study. Across 20 BixBench3 tasks encompassing the generation of 138 unique artifacts, we find that 13 frontier models achieve scores ranging from 0.00 for Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite to 0.48 for GPT 5.6 Sol. Agents perform worse on tasks with larger raw datasets (0.36 on tasks with <100 GB versus 0.10 on tasks with >100 GB) and on analyses requiring more sequential steps (0.36 at 1-2 steps vs 0.24 at 3+). On average, agents use 6.8 hours, 102 million tokens, and $43 to complete each task, with the longest attempts consuming 24 hours, 1.07 billion tokens, and $525. Notably, the highest-scoring agents used fewer tokens and were cheaper than less performant options. These results reveal that LLMs vary substantially in their ability to (1) execute multiple sequential analysis steps coherently, (2) manage large quantities of raw data, and (3) work across scientific domains.

papers.title_zh: BixBench3：在科研规模计算生物学任务上对AI智能体进行基准测试
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）有望通过自动化计算分析来加速生物研究。然而，AI智能体在完整研究规模上开展计算生物学工作的能力尚未得到系统评估。为此，我们引入了BixBench3，一个衡量AI智能体从原始生物数据到科学结果处理能力的基准。我们设计BixBench3任务以模拟科学家向智能体委派工作的过程：科学家选择研究问题和顶层方法，然后将所有分析的实施委派给智能体。在每个任务中，智能体接收研究目标、方法指导以及来自已发表科学研究的原始数据，并且必须执行一系列分析以实现研究目标。这些分析产生的数据产物——例如峰值调用矩阵或差异表达表——会根据原始研究中生成并报告的对应产物进行程序化评分。在涵盖生成138个唯一产物的20个BixBench3任务中，我们发现13个前沿模型的得分范围从Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite的0.00到GPT 5.6 Sol的0.48。智能体在原始数据集更大的任务上表现更差（<100 GB的任务得分为0.36，而>100 GB的任务为0.10），在需要更多顺序步骤的分析上表现也更差（1-2步为0.36，3步及以上为0.24）。平均而言，智能体完成每个任务需使用6.8小时、1.02亿个token和43美元，最长的尝试消耗了24小时、10.7亿个token和525美元。值得注意的是，得分最高的智能体使用的token更少，成本也低于性能较差的选项。这些结果表明，不同LLM在以下能力上存在显著差异：（1）连贯地执行多个顺序分析步骤，（2）管理大量原始数据，以及（3）跨科学领域工作。

papers.title: Recursive Experiential-Working Memory Evolution for Long-Horizon Agent Harnesses
papers.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) remains hard in long-horizon tasks, where growing histories obscure the task state and misalign skill invocation. We introduce Recuris, a recursive Experiential-Working Memory architecture for long-horizon agent harnesses, in which Working Memory tracks task progress and guides skill selection from Experiential Memory, grounding skill use in current needs rather than the full history. This coupling also turns execution into structured evidence that localizes failures to specific memory components. Across tasks, a fixed Meta-Agent turns that evidence into localized, validation-gated updates to Skill Memory that reshape execution and yield new evidence, forming a bounded recursive memory-evolution loop. Across four long-horizon benchmarks and ten models, Recuris improves task success in 35 of the 37 completed model-benchmark pairs, carrying frontier models to SOTA-level task success: on tau-bench it adds +17.8 points to GPT-5.6 Sol and +15.6 to Claude Opus 5, taking Opus 5 to 87.9%, and +16.6/+13.5 points on Qwen3.6-27B/35B on SkillFlow. The advantage widens as the interaction horizon grows, to +32.2 points on the longest tasks, and common long-horizon failures fall by up to 80%. These results position recursively evolving memory as a scalable foundation for RSI, enabling agents to continuously transform accumulated experience into increasingly effective long-horizon behavior. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/Recuris

papers.title_zh: 面向长视野智能体框架的递归经验-工作记忆演化
papers.abstract_zh: 递归自我改进（RSI）在长视野任务中仍然困难，因为不断增长的历史记录掩盖了任务状态并导致技能调用失配。我们提出了Recuris，一种用于长视野智能体框架的递归经验-工作记忆架构，其中工作记忆跟踪任务进度并从经验记忆中选择技能，将技能使用建立在当前需求而非完整历史之上。这种耦合还将执行转化为结构化证据，使失败能够定位到特定的记忆组件。在各种任务中，一个固定的元智能体将该证据转化为对技能记忆的局部化、经验证门控的更新，这些更新重塑执行并产生新的证据，形成一个有界的递归记忆演化循环。在四个长视野基准和十个模型上，Recuris在37个已完成的模型-基准对中提升了35个的任务成功率，将前沿模型推向最先进水平的任务成功率：在tau-bench上，它为GPT-5.6 Sol增加了+17.8个百分点，为Claude Opus 5增加了+15.6个百分点，使Opus 5达到87.9%，并在SkillFlow上为Qwen3.6-27B/35B增加了+16.6/+13.5个百分点。随着交互视野的增长，优势进一步扩大，在最长任务上达到+32.2个百分点，常见的长期失败下降高达80%。这些结果将递归演化的记忆定位为RSI的可扩展基础，使智能体能够不断将积累的经验转化为日益有效的长视野行为。代码：https://github.com/Gen-Verse/Recuris

papers.title: Prompt Structure Redistributes, Not Reduces: An Empirical Analysis of Security-Weaknesses in LLM-Generated Python Code
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly generate code from natural-language prompts, making prompt engineering a key mechanism for shaping the security of generated software. Structured and security-oriented prompts are widely used to encourage safer code, yet their effects extend beyond whether detected weaknesses are simply present or absent. Using 424 security-sensitive Python tasks, we generate solutions with GPT-4o and LLaMA 3.1-8B under five prompt variants that progressively add structural and security guidance, and evaluate them with Bandit and CodeQL along two axes: generation compliance and security weakness prevalence, severity, and CWE distributions. Structured prompting substantially reduces refusals (e.g., GPT-4o invalid outputs drop from 338 of 424 to 37-52), enabling large-scale analysis, but security-oriented refinements do not consistently reduce overall weakness prevalence. For GPT-4o, stronger prompts primarily redistribute risk: high-severity findings fall (20.8% to 13.6%) while low-severity findings rise (32% to 43.5%); LLaMA shows weaker, less consistent shifts. We also observe security-driven semantic drift, where stricter prompts silently remove or rewrite explicitly requested unsafe constructs. Overall, prompt structure improves compliance but is an unreliable substitute for robust security controls in LLM-assisted development.

papers.summary_zh:
## 一句话结论
结构化提示能提升 LLM（大语言模型）生成 Python 代码的“生成合规性”，但并不能可靠减少安全弱点；它主要是把风险从高危“重新分配”为低危，因此不能替代稳健的安全控制。

## 问题与动机
LLM 越来越多地根据自然语言提示生成代码，提示工程（prompt engineering）因此成为影响生成软件安全性的关键机制。结构化和安全导向的提示常被用来鼓励生成更安全的代码，但它们的效果并不仅仅体现在检测到的弱点“有或无”上，还可能改变弱点的严重程度、类型分布以及模型的行为方式。摘要因此引入更细粒度的实证分析。

## 方法与技术路线
- **研究对象与设定**：摘要使用 424 个安全敏感的 Python 编程任务，在 GPT-4o 和 LLaMA 3.1-8B 两个模型上，采用五种提示变体（prompt variants）生成解决方案。这些变体逐步加入结构性指导和安全指导；摘要未说明各变体的具体措辞、任务来源或筛选标准。
- **评估流程**：对生成代码使用 Bandit（Python 代码弱点检测工具）和 CodeQL（代码分析工具）进行扫描，并沿两条轴评估：一是生成合规性（generation compliance），即模型是否输出有效代码、是否拒绝生成；二是安全弱点状况，包括弱点

papers.title: StarHarness: Evolving Harnesses with Stratified Search for Enterprise Environments
papers.abstract: We present StarHarness, a framework for evolving environment-specific agent harnesses while keeping model weights fixed. The evolved harness can include prompt and task framing, tool interfaces, skills, MCP-backed providers, subagent structure, and agent-loop configuration. StarHarness constructs a compact evolution pool by stratifying tasks according to baseline failure behavior, separates proposer-visible search tasks from proposer-hidden selection tasks, and reserves held-out tasks for evaluating generalization. Across ITBench SRE, EnterpriseOps-Gym ITSM, and AutomationBench Finance, harness evolution improves full-benchmark performance by 20-35 percentage points over the default harness after 4-12 accepted changes per environment. These gains persist on tasks excluded from evolution and transfer without re-evolution across GPT and Qwen model families. Trace analysis links the improvements to interface repairs, environment conventions, and operational knowledge that compresses search, with fewer false-positive diagnoses and shorter trajectories in several settings. StarHarness therefore offers a practical way to reduce persistent model-environment mismatch in tool-rich enterprise tasks.

papers.title_zh: StarHarness：面向企业环境的分层搜索harness演化
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了StarHarness，一个在保持模型权重不变的情况下演化特定于环境的智能体harness的框架。演化出的harness可包括提示和任务构建、工具接口、技能、基于MCP的提供者、子代理结构和代理循环配置。StarHarness通过根据基线失败行为对任务进行分层来构建紧凑的演化池，将提议者可见的搜索任务与提议者隐藏的选择任务分开，并保留留出任务以评估泛化能力。在ITBench SRE、EnterpriseOps-Gym ITSM和AutomationBench Finance上，harness演化在每个环境接受4-12次更改后，将全基准性能比默认harness提高了20-35个百分点。这些增益在从演化中排除的任务上持续存在，并在GPT和Qwen模型家族之间无需重新演化即可迁移。轨迹分析将这些改进归因于接口修复、环境惯例和压缩搜索的操作知识，在若干设置中减少了误报诊断并缩短了轨迹。因此，StarHarness提供了一种实用的方法，以减少工具丰富的企业任务中持续存在的模型-环境不匹配。

papers.title: StepGuard: Learning Step-Level Guardrails with Scalable Supervision and Safety-Utility Balancing
papers.abstract: LLM-based agents can interact with external environments through tool invocation, but this capability also introduces security risks such as file modification, information leakage, and unauthorized actions. Existing guardrails often evaluate completed trajectories, leaving pre-execution monitoring of step-level actions underexplored. We propose StepGuard, a step-level guard model that can audit completed agent trajectories and check tool actions before they are executed. To train StepGuard, we introduce StepGen, an automatic data engine that generates safe and unsafe trajectories with the same context but different actions at the risky step. To further reduce over-defense and under-defense, we propose Balance-GRPO, which dynamically balances learning between safe and unsafe actions based on their observed accuracy. Experiments show that StepGuard achieves the highest average accuracy among open-weight guard models, with performance comparable to GPT-5.4. When used to guard agents on AgentDojo and AgentDyn, StepGuard reduces mean attack success rate by 77.3% relative to the no-guard setting, while mean utility drops by only 2.8 percentage points.

papers.relevance_reason_zh: 关注LLM代理的工具调用安全护栏，属于大模型安全，但非安全推理协议。
papers.summary_zh:
### 一句话结论
StepGuard 是一个面向 LLM 代理工具调用的步骤级防护模型，能在工具执行前检查动作，根据摘要报告，可在仅小幅降低效用的前提下显著降低攻击成功率。

### 问题与动机
LLM-based agents（基于大语言模型的智能体）通过 tool invocation（工具调用）与外部环境交互，但引入了文件修改、信息泄露、未经授权操作等安全风险。现有 guardrails（安全护栏）通常只评估 completed trajectories（已完成轨迹），对 pre-execution（执行前）的 step-level（步骤级）动作监控不足。StepGuard 正是为弥补这一缺口而设计。

### 方法与技术路线
- **研究对象与设定**：LLM 代理的逐步工具调用动作。模型需要同时支持两类任务：审计已完成的 agent trajectories（代理轨迹），以及检查即将执行的 tool actions（工具动作）是否安全。
- **训练数据生成**：作者引入 StepGen，一个 automatic data engine（自动数据引擎），生成 safe/unsafe（安全/不安全）轨迹对。这些轨迹对具有相同的上下文，只在“risky step”（风险步骤）处采取不同动作，从而构造可对比的训练信号，帮助模型学习在关键步骤上做安全判别。
- **学习平衡**：为避免模型偏向“过度防御”（over-defense）或“防御不足”（under-defense），作者提出 Balance-GRPO。该方法基于安全与不安全动作各自被观察到的准确率，动态调整两类样本的学习权重，使训练在防护效果和正常可用性之间保持平衡。
- **输出与衔接**：StepGuard 对当前步骤动作输出安全性判断，可用于执行前拦截或事后审计；StepGen 和 Balance-GRPO 分别是数据准备与训练优化模块，服务于 StepGuard 的训练。摘要未说明具体的数据集规模、训练参数或护栏部署细节。

### 主要结果
摘要报告，StepGuard 在 open-weight guard models（开放权重护栏模型）中达到最高平均准确率，性能与 GPT-5.4 相当。在用于保护 AgentDojo 和 AgentDyn 上的代理时，与 no-guard（无护栏）设定相比，平均 attack success rate（攻击成功率）降低 77.3%，同时平均 utility（效用）仅下降 2.8 个百分点。

### 为什么与兴趣相关
该工作属于大模型安全方向，关注 LLM 代理工具调用的实时防护，而非安全推理协议。步骤级护栏为在动作执行前阻断风险提供了一种可行思路，与代理系统部署中的安全监控需求直接相关。

papers.title: MoTE: Mixture of Task Experts for Multi-Task Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Procedural video-language models must solve heterogeneous tasks from the same visual evidence, including action recognition, forecasting, and procedure prediction. Dense transformer decoders share the same feed-forward networks across tasks, which can entangle task behavior and make controlled capability expansion difficult. Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) decoders provide conditional computation, but token-level learned routing is not naturally aligned with task-level procedural objectives. We propose MoTE (Mixture of Task Experts), a decoder architecture that converts large language model feed-forward networks into task-specific experts while keeping the multimodal backbone shared. Each example follows one sample-level task route, so active task-expert computation remains independent of the number of stored task experts. We instantiate this design as VideoLLM-MoTE and evaluate it on five COIN benchmarks using explicit task routes. The five-expert model activates ~2B LLM parameters per sample and achieves higher average top-1 accuracy than recent VideoLLM baselines. Under the same expert topology, it improves over dense all-expert activation and learned sparse-routing controls. These results show that task-structured routing provides an interpretable and compute-efficient decoder alternative for multi-task video-language learning.

papers.title_zh: MoTE：用于多任务视频理解的任务专家混合
papers.abstract_zh: 程序性视频语言模型必须从相同的视觉证据中解决异构任务，包括动作识别、预测和程序预测。密集Transformer解码器跨任务共享相同的前馈网络，这可能会纠缠任务行为并使受控能力扩展变得困难。稀疏混合专家（MoE）解码器提供条件计算，但基于token的学习路由并不自然地与任务级程序目标对齐。我们提出MoTE（任务专家混合），一种解码器架构，将大语言模型的前馈网络转换为任务特定专家，同时保持多模态主干共享。每个样本遵循一条样本级任务路由，因此活跃的任务专家计算与存储的任务专家数量无关。我们将此设计实例化为VideoLLM-MoTE，并使用显式任务路由在五个COIN基准上对其进行评估。五个专家的模型每个样本激活~2B LLM参数，并取得比近期VideoLLM基线更高的平均top-1准确率。在相同专家拓扑下，它优于密集的全专家激活和学习的稀疏路由控制。这些结果表明，任务结构化路由为多任务视频语言学习提供了一种可解释且计算高效的解码器替代方案。

papers.title: RACE: Scalable Statistical Estimation of Functional Consistency in LLM Neurons
papers.abstract: Discovering stable neuron behavior across entire domains remains a challenge in mechanistic interpretability. Existing methods often rely on instance-level point estimates or computationally expensive procedures, which either obscure population-level variability or limit scalable domain-wide analysis. We present RACE (Residual Alignment for Consistency Estimation), a forward-pass statistical framework that evaluates the domain-wide functional consistency of Transformer neurons. Perturbation experiments demonstrate that RACE achieves superior domain specificity compared to gradient-based point estimates. Meanwhile, token-distribution-level results verify the association between the selected neurons and the target domain. Furthermore, its computational overhead is two orders of magnitude lower than that of gradient-based methods.

papers.title_zh: RACE：LLM神经元功能一致性的可扩展统计估计
papers.abstract_zh: 发现跨整个领域的稳定神经元行为仍然是机制可解释性中的一个挑战。现有方法通常依赖实例级点估计或计算成本高昂的方法，这要么掩盖了总体水平的变异性，要么限制了可扩展的全域分析。我们提出了RACE（Residual Alignment for Consistency Estimation，一致性估计的残差对齐），一个评估Transformer神经元全域功能一致性的前向传播统计框架。扰动实验表明，与基于梯度的点估计相比，RACE实现了更优的领域特异性。同时，词元分布层面的结果验证了所选神经元与目标领域之间的关联。此外，其计算开销比基于梯度的方法低两个数量级。

papers.title: Expectation, Backlash, Recovery, and Excitement: How Model Releases Shape Reddit Perceptions of Conversational AI Systems
papers.abstract: Conversational AI systems (CAISes) continuously change through model releases, feature updates, safety interventions, and access-policy shifts, yet user perceptions are often studied as static snapshots. We conduct a long-term, large-scale analysis of Reddit discussions to examine how users perceive CAIS model release interventions across providers. By combining sentiment classification and thematic concept analysis, we show that CAIS perceptions are dynamic and intervention-sensitive. Anthropic exhibits the clearest positive release profile through Claude Code and product-model fit, OpenAI shows backlash-and-recovery dynamics around GPT-5 and GPT-5.1, Grok-3 is shaped by provider identity and political discourse, and DeepSeek-R1 combines engineering praise with concerns about censorship, access, and reliability. These findings show that model releases are not merely technical updates, but user-facing interventions that reshape sentiment, expectations, and public discussion.

papers.title_zh: 期待、反弹、恢复与兴奋：模型发布如何塑造Reddit上对对话式AI系统的感知
papers.abstract_zh: 对话式AI系统（CAISes）通过模型发布、功能更新、安全干预和访问政策变化而持续演变，然而用户感知常常被作为静态快照来研究。我们对Reddit讨论进行了长期、大规模的分析，以考察用户如何跨提供商感知CAIS模型发布干预。通过结合情感分类和主题概念分析，我们表明CAIS感知是动态的且对干预敏感。Anthropic通过Claude Code和产品-模型匹配展现出最清晰的正面发布特征，OpenAI围绕GPT-5和GPT-5.1表现出反弹与恢复的动态，Grok-3受到提供商身份和政治话语的塑造，而DeepSeek-R1则将工程上的赞誉与对审查、访问和可靠性的担忧结合在一起。这些发现表明，模型发布不仅仅是技术更新，还是面向用户的干预措施，能够重塑情感、期望和公众讨论。

papers.title: Quantization Effects on Bangla Language Understanding in Large Language Models: A Systematic Evaluation
papers.abstract: Post-training quantization lowers the memory footprint of Large Language Models (LLMs) and speeds up inference, which is why it is now common for on-device deployment. Most of what we know about its effects, however, comes from English benchmarks. It is not clear whether the same holds for morphologically complex, low-resource languages such as Bangla, and this gap is what we address here. We evaluate three model families---Qwen-2.5-7B, LLaMA-3.1-8B, and GPT-OSS-20B---in full precision and in three quantized formats (GPTQ-Int8, GPTQ-Q8, GGUF-W8A16) across five Bangla natural language understanding benchmarks (Bangla MMLU, CommonsenseQA-BN, OpenBookQA-BN, PIQA-BN, and BoolQ-BN), using zero-shot evaluation through lm-evaluation-harness. To our knowledge this is the first controlled comparison of quantization formats on Bangla NLU. The three families do not respond the same way: GPT-OSS loses up to 57.35% accuracy on reasoning-heavy tasks under GGUF-W8A16, while Qwen and LLaMA hold steady under GPTQ, and in a few cases the quantized version edges out the full-precision one. BoolQ-BN, a comprehension task, stays stable across all three families regardless of format. papers.title_zh: 量化对大语言模型孟加拉语理解的影响：一项系统性评估
papers.abstract_zh: 训练后量化降低了大型语言模型（LLMs）的内存占用并加速了推理，因此目前常用于设备端部署。然而，我们对其影响的大部分认识来自英语基准测试。尚不清楚对于形态复杂、低资源语言（如孟加拉语）是否同样如此，而这一研究空白正是我们在本文中所要填补的。我们评估了三个模型家族——Qwen-2.5-7B、LLaMA-3.1-8B和GPT-OSS-20B——在全精度以及三种量化格式（GPTQ-Int8、GPTQ-Q8、GGUF-W8A16）下，跨越五个孟加拉语自然语言理解基准（Bangla MMLU、CommonsenseQA-BN、OpenBookQA-BN、PIQA-BN和BoolQ-BN），并采用通过lm-evaluation-harness进行的零样本评估。据我们所知，这是首次对孟加拉语NLU上量化格式进行的受控比较。这三个模型家族的反应并不相同：GPT-OSS在GGUF-W8A16下于推理密集型任务上损失高达57.35%的准确率，而Qwen和LLaMA在GPTQ下保持稳定，且在少数情况下量化版本略优于全精度版本。BoolQ-BN这一阅读理解任务在三个模型家族中无论采用何种格式均保持稳定。综合来看，这些结果表明量化可以很好地用于孟加拉语部署，但架构和量化方法的选择比单纯的位宽更为重要。我们讨论了这些发现对在受限硬件上选择运行模型的实际意义。

papers.title: Delayed Optimizer-State Transport Shapes Short-Horizon Training Decisions
papers.abstract: Adaptive optimizers retain gradient history in moment variables, allowing a local change in loss weighting to alter later updates. We examine whether this delayed transport is large enough to change prospective short-horizon decisions. On committed future-minibatch sequences, we differentiate eight-step AdamW trajectories through the complete model--optimizer state and select exposure-matched Math--Code loss schedules before independent evaluation. Across 12 unused 0.3M Transformer histories, full transport lowers token-disjoint loss relative to an optimizer-aware immediate derivative in 10/12 histories (mean benefit $4.71\times10^{-4}$; exact one-sided sign test, $p=0.0193$). The two controllers act equally often but select different schedules in 60/96 windows. Crossed checkpoint--future-path tests attribute this reordering to the interaction between optimizer state and near-future data, while an independent Ising--CNN experiment shows that deleting moment-state transport destroys accurate response prediction. Full-transport scores also concentrate exact-rollout winners in larger candidate libraries, focusing finite-amplitude evaluation on a shortlist. On these committed short paths, optimizer memory and near-future data order are therefore actionable components of the training state, providing a mechanism-based criterion for when finite-horizon rather than one-step intervention is required.

papers.title_zh: 延迟的优化器状态传输塑造短视界训练决策
papers.abstract_zh: 自适应优化器在矩变量中保留梯度历史，使得损失加权中的局部变化能够改变后续更新。我们检验这种延迟传输是否足够大，以改变预期的短视界决策。在已确定的未来小批量序列上，我们通过完整的模型-优化器状态对八步AdamW轨迹进行微分，并在独立评估之前选择暴露匹配的Math-Code损失调度。在12个未使用的0.3M Transformer历史中，相较于优化器感知的即时导数，完整传输在10/12个历史中降低了令牌不相交损失（平均收益$4.71\times10^{-4}$；精确单侧符号检验，$p=0.0193$）。两种控制器以相同频率起作用，但在60/96个窗口中选择了不同的调度。交叉检查点-未来路径测试将此重排序归因于优化器状态与近期未来数据之间的交互，而独立的Ising-CNN实验表明，删除矩状态传输会破坏准确的响应预测。完整传输得分还将精确展开赢家集中在更大的候选库中，将有限振幅评估聚焦于候选名单。因此，在这些已确定的短路径上，优化器记忆和近期未来数据顺序是训练状态的可操作组成部分，为何时需要有限视界而非单步干预提供了基于机制的判据。

papers.title: SeisMamba: Low-Latency Single-Station Seismic Magnitude Estimation for Spatially Distributed Earthquake Early Warning
papers.abstract: Rapid earthquake magnitude estimation is central to earthquake early warning, yet many operational systems depend on dense regional seismic networks and region-specific calibration. This creates a spatial coverage barrier for high-risk areas with sparse sensing infrastructure. Single-station learning offers a lower-cost alternative, but existing models often face an accuracy--latency trade-off and may degrade under regional distribution shift. We present SeisMamba, a lightweight Mamba-based architecture for low-latency magnitude estimation from minimally processed three-component seismic waveforms recorded at a single station. SeisMamba combines hierarchical convolutional encoding, sparse selective state-space modelling, multi-scale feature fusion, and an auxiliary temporal prediction head to support efficient long-sequence waveform analysis. On the STEAD benchmark, SeisMamba achieves the best MSE, RMSE, and $R^2$ among tested baselines while requiring only 0.55 ms for a batch of 32 waveforms on an NVIDIA T4 GPU, making it about three times faster than transformer-based baselines. We further conduct a Chile--Taiwan regional hold-out experiment as a diagnostic test of cross-region deployment, where SeisMamba retains useful performance on geographically unseen seismic regions. These results suggest that selective state-space waveform modelling provides a promising accuracy--latency backbone for spatially distributed, low-cost earthquake early warning.

papers.title_zh: SeisMamba：面向空间分布式地震预警的低延迟单台震级估计
papers.abstract_zh: 快速地震震级估计是地震预警的核心，但许多运行系统依赖于密集的区域地震台网和特定区域的标定。这给传感基础设施稀疏的高风险地区造成了空间覆盖障碍。单台学习提供了一种更低成本的替代方案，但现有模型常常面临精度与延迟之间的权衡，并可能在区域分布偏移下性能退化。我们提出了SeisMamba，一种轻量级、基于Mamba的架构，用于从单台记录的最少处理的三分量地震波形进行低延迟震级估计。SeisMamba结合了层次卷积编码、稀疏选择性状态空间建模、多尺度特征融合以及一个辅助时间预测头，以支持高效的长序列波形分析。在STEAD基准上，SeisMamba在测试的基线中取得了最佳的MSE、RMSE和$R^2$，同时在NVIDIA T4 GPU上处理一批32个波形仅需0.55毫秒，比基于Transformer的基线快约三倍。我们还进行了智利—台湾区域留出实验，作为跨区域部署的诊断测试，SeisMamba在地理上未见过的地震区域保持了有用的性能。这些结果表明，选择性状态空间波形建模为空间分布的低成本地震预警提供了一种有前景的精度—延迟骨干。

papers.title: Neurosymbolic Alignment for Physiologically-Safe Clinical Language Models
papers.abstract: Clinical LLMs can generate recommendations that are factually plausible yet physiologically unsafe. We investigate whether safety alignment can be improved by grounding preference optimization in structured physiological knowledge rather than text-only supervision. Methods: We propose Neurosymbolic Alignment, a training-time framework that couples a 7B clinical LLM with an HGNN-based Physiological World Model over an 847K-node biomedical knowledge graph. Candidate responses are scored using homeostatic constraints, multi-hop path plausibility, and drug-interaction penalties, and the resulting rankings drive iterative on-policy ORPO updates. Evaluation is performed on the Clinical Safety Benchmark (CSB), a 2,500-scenario benchmark for physiological constraint violations in generative clinical reasoning. Results: Relative to ORPO, the proposed method improves CSS from 69.5% to 90.8% (+21.3 pp), reduces physician-evaluated HR from 14.1% to 5.1% on the blinded subset, and improves DID from 72.8% to 91.6%. These gains are corroborated by an HGNN-independent Rule-Engine Safety Score (RSS: 86.4%, +21.2 pp over ORPO; r=0.97 concordance with CSS). The method also exceeds GPT-4 (5-shot) on all safety metrics despite a 10x parameter disadvantage, and outperforms an inference-time self-correction pipeline (SFT+SelfCorrect) by 11.4 pp CSS. Under synthetic EHR-style noise, 84.2% CSS is retained. Ablation analysis shows that HGNN scoring (-16.2 pp) and iterative training (-11.5 pp) are the dominant contributors. PhysioScore calibration against 200 clinician labels yielded ECE = 0.038 and kappa = 0.91. Conclusion: Training-time physiological grounding produces measurable and independently verifiable safety improvements in open-weight clinical LLMs under controlled evaluation. External validation on real clinical data is required to determine whether these gains transfer to deployment settings

papers.summary_zh:
## 一句话结论

本文提出一种训练时的“神经符号对齐”（Neurosymbolic Alignment）框架，将临床语言模型的偏好优化建立在结构化生理知识之上，显著提升其输出建议的生理安全性。

## 问题与动机

临床大语言模型（LLM）可能生成“事实表面上合理、但生理上不安全”的医疗建议。作者关注：能否用结构化生理知识替代纯文本监督，通过偏好优化（preference optimization）改进安全对齐效果。

## 方法与技术路线

- **研究对象与设定**：以一个 7B 参数的临床 LLM 为基础，引入一个基于 HGNN（异构图神经网络）的“生理世界模型”（Physiological World Model），模型背后的生物医学知识图谱包含 847K 个节点。
- **输入与关键步骤**：候选临床响应会接受三类生理约束评分：稳态约束（homeostatic constraints）、多跳路径合理性（multi-hop path plausibility）、以及药物相互作用惩罚（drug-interaction penalties）。这些评分形成排序结果。
- **训练过程**：上述排序结果用于驱动“在线策略 ORPO 更新”（on-policy ORPO；ORPO 为一种偏好优化算法，原文未给出全称），形成迭代式训练时对齐。文本没有披露具体更新步数、超参数或训练环境细节。
- **评估设定**：使用临床安全基准（Clinical Safety Benchmark, CSB），含 2,500 个关于生成式临床推理中“生理约束违反”的场景。论文摘要未说明具体提示模板、候选响应数量或随机种子等设置。

## 主要结果

- 相比 ORPO 基线，提出的方法将 CSS 指标从 69.5% 提升到 90.8%（+21.3 个百分点）。
- 在盲法子集上，医师评估的 HR（伤害率指标，原文未展开全称）从 14.1% 降至 5.1%。
- DID 指标从 72.8% 提升到 91.6%。
- 使用与 HGNN 无关的规则引擎安全评分（RSS）进行验证，RSS 为 86.4%（较 ORPO 高 21.2 个百分点），与 CSS 的一致性系数 r=0.97。
- 该方法在所有安全指标上超过 GPT-4（5-shot），尽管模型参数量小 10 倍；并优于推理时自修正流水线（SFT+SelfCorrect），CSS 高 11.4 个百分点。
- 在合成电子健康记录式噪声下，仍保留 84.2% 的 CSS。
- 消融分析显示，HGNN 评分和迭代训练是主要贡献因素（分别造成 −16.2 个百分点与 −11.5 个百分点）。
- 使用 200 名临床医生标注进行 PhysioScore 校准，得到 ECE（期望校准误差）为 0.038，kappa=0.91。

## 为什么与兴趣相关

这项工作直接面向大模型安全对齐中的高风险场景：医疗推荐不能仅追求文本流畅或表面合理，而需要可验证的生理安全约束。它表明训练时融入结构化知识比推理后修正更有效，且不依赖模型规模扩大。对于开放权重临床模型的安全部署，该方法提供了可量化的评估路径；但摘要也明确指出，仍需在真实临床数据上外部验证，以判断这些提升能否迁移到实际部署环境。

papers.title: Mahalanobis-Based Multi-Head Attention for Complex State Propagation
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose \textbf{Mahalanobis-Based Multi-Head Attention} (MHA-CSP), a novel attention mechanism that replaces the standard dot-product with a \textbf{Mahalanobis distance-based RBF kernel}, which effectively computes attention in an infinite-dimensional feature space without increasing the parameter count. Crucially, the positive definiteness of the Mahalanobis distance enables a \textbf{direct construction of Tree Attention}: attention scores are built directly from accumulated distances, with a LogSumExp correction that rectifies the raw distance by subtracting the log-sum of edge exponentials. Moreover, the multi-head Mahalanobis distance matrices are themselves repurposed to construct an \textbf{attention meshing mechanism}, enabling cross-head kernel collaboration that simultaneously boosts accuracy and training efficiency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MHA-CSP, with only 119K parameters and \textbf{teacher forcing applied exclusively at the final hidden state}, consistently outperforms Transformer and GCN baselines trained from scratch under identical conditions on long-sequence state tracking tasks. While these baselines rely on dense attention or graph propagation, MHA-CSP achieves robust structured reasoning via synthetic distance rectification---powered by Mahalanobis-based attention---and efficient information bypass inherited from the CSP backbone. This result highlights the effectiveness of complex-valued state propagation with collaborative multi-head rectification in capturing symbolic structures, establishing a new efficiency-performance trade-off for structured reasoning.

While these baselines rely on dense attention or graph propagation, MHA-CSP achieves robust structured reasoning via synthetic distance rectification---powered by Mahalanobis-based attention---and efficient information bypass inherited from the CSP backbone. This result highlights the effectiveness of complex-valued state propagation with collaborative multi-head rectification in capturing symbolic structures, establishing a new efficiency-performance trade-off for structured reasoning.

papers.title_zh: 基于马氏距离的多头注意力用于复杂状态传播

papers.title: The Handoff Tax: Continuing Non-Native Trajectories in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Coding agents perform long-running tasks spanning dozens of model calls, tool uses, and code edits. As these runs unfold, users face a practical cost-quality trade-off: escalating to a stronger model when a cheaper one struggles, or downshifting once the hard reasoning is complete. Each switch requires the receiver to continue a non-native trajectory produced by another model. We study how this handoff affects quality and cost, and how varying the trajectory information inherited by the receiver changes the outcome. Using pairs of low-cost, low-capability (LC) and high-cost, high-capability (HC) models from the Claude and GPT families, we vary handoff direction, timing, and interface, comparing full-trajectory transfer, compaction, and trajectory removal while preserving the repository state. Across both model families, full-trajectory escalation recovers less than half of the LC-to-HC quality gap while incurring a substantial cost premium. We term this cost-quality penalty the handoff tax. By contrast, downshift offers a favorable cost-quality point. Interestingly, the preferred interface also reverses with direction: reducing LC-model trajectory information improves escalation quality, whereas removing the HC-model trajectory reduces downshift quality.

papers.title_zh: 交接税：LLM智能体中延续非原生轨迹的代价
papers.abstract_zh: 编码智能体执行长时间运行的任务，涉及数十次模型调用、工具使用和代码编辑。随着这些运行过程的展开，用户面临一个实际的成本-质量权衡：当较便宜的模型遇到困难时升级到更强的模型，或者在困难推理完成后降级。每次切换都要求接收方延续由另一个模型产生的非原生轨迹。我们研究了这种交接如何影响质量和成本，以及接收方继承的轨迹信息的变化如何改变结果。使用来自Claude和GPT系列的廉价低能力（LC）和高成本高能力（HC）模型配对，我们变化交接方向、时机和接口，比较全轨迹传递、压缩以及保留仓库状态的同时移除轨迹。在两个模型系列中，全轨迹升级仅恢复了不到LC到HC质量差距的一半，同时产生了可观的成本溢价。我们将这种成本-质量惩罚称为交接税。相比之下，降级提供了一个有利的成本-质量点。有趣的是，首选接口也随方向反转：减少LC模型轨迹信息可提高升级质量，而移除HC模型轨迹则降低降级质量。

papers.title: Can a Dynamic Internal Field Govern a Transformer's Cognition? Certifiability, not Superiority, in Homeostatic Compute Control
papers.abstract: An intelligent system does not merely reason: it governs its own reasoning - how much to compute, when to stop, which module to activate. Can that role be played by a dynamic internal field - a low-dimensional homeostatic state with explicit physics and certified stability - that modulates cognition without performing it? Ours is a field on the module graph governed by a family of PDEs on the graph Laplacian, advancing with an adaptive-depth reasoner. We certify the stability of the integrator of the whole family - an integrator certificate, not a closed-loop one. New, and proved here: a discrete Schur-Cohn criterion for Verlet with velocity coupling, necessary and sufficient per latent root, with no commutation hypothesis. The answer is threefold: substance no, structure only in part, certifiability yes. The type of the field's physics is irrelevant for accuracy: wave, diffusion, gated mixtures and a 2D Navier-Stokes substrate tie. A twenty-seed preregistered deconfounding campaign bounds the structural claim: at equalized caps the second-order effect is strong in one family (+0.087 [+0.042, +0.132], t=4.0) but is not detected in the other (+0.014 [-0.013, +0.040], n.s.), so part of the original contrast was capacity, not order; and a matched-interface GRU is indistinguishable in the first and nominally exceeds the field in the second (-0.035 [-0.067, -0.002]). What distinguishes the field is not capability but that its one-step operator admits an exact runtime stability check - a difference of kind, not of existence: learned recurrences carry certificates too, sufficient and conservative ones. A kill-gate with a positive control finds no evidence for the field as evidence accumulator (Delta AUC +0.0007 [-0.0065, +0.0079] vs a 0.03 threshold). A dynamic internal field is a viable, certifiable compute governor, but not an enhancer of cognition: it modulates, it does not think.

papers.title_zh: 动态内场能否支配Transformer的认知？——同态计算控制中的可认证性而非优越性
papers.abstract_zh: 一个智能系统不仅仅是推理：它还支配自身的推理——计算多少、何时停止、激活哪个模块。这个角色能否由一个动态内场——一个具有显式物理和已认证稳定性的低维同态状态——来扮演，它对认知进行调节而非执行认知？我们的场是模块图上的一个场，由图拉普拉斯上的一族偏微分方程支配，并随自适应深度推理器一同推进。我们认证了整族积分器的稳定性——这是一个积分器证书，而非闭环证书。本文新提出并证明了：一个用于带速度耦合的Verlet算法的离散Schur-Cohn判据，对每个潜在根既是必要的也是充分的，且无需交换性假设。答案是三重性的：实质上不能，结构上仅部分能，可认证性上能。场的物理类型对精度无关紧要：波动、扩散、门控混合以及二维Navier-Stokes基底均不产生差异。一项二十种子预注册去混杂战役限定了这一结构性主张：在均等化上限下，二阶效应在一个族中较强（+0.087 [+0.042, +0.132]，t=4.0），但在另一个族中未被检测到（+0.014 [-0.013, +0.040]，不显著），因此原始对比的一部分是容量而非阶次；并且一个匹配接口的GRU在第一个族中无法区分，在第二个族中名义上超过该场（-0.035 [-0.067, -0.002]）。区分该场的不是能力，而是其单步算子允许进行精确的运行时稳定性检查——这是一种种类上的差异，而非存在性上的差异：学习到的循环同样携带证书，这些证书是充分且保守的。一个带有阳性对照的kill-gate未发现该场作为证据累积器的证据（Delta AUC +0.0007 [-0.0065, +0.0079]，对比0.03阈值）。动态内场是一个可行的、可认证的计算调节器，但不是认知的增强器：它进行调节，它不思考。

papers.title: Benchmarking LLM Judges for Voice-Agent Evaluation: Reliability, Calibration, and Human Oversight
papers.abstract: Evaluating conversational voice agents at scale re- quires reliable assessment methods that capture both observ- able interaction quality and the contextual judgment typically provided by human evaluators. We investigate LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation by comparing human judgments with GPT-4.1 and GPT-5 on telecom and retail voice-agent conversations, across conversational quality and safety dimensions. The same interac- tions are scored under three evaluation configurations, p0, p1, and p2, to test whether automated judgments are sensitive to the evaluation setup and whether observed patterns generalize across configurations and judge models. Beyond aggregate agreement, we examine metric-level correlations, evaluator consistency, and systematic human-LLM disagreement to identify which conver- sational attributes can be judged reliably by automation and which remain sensitive to interpretation and context. Effective voice-agent evaluation is also shaped by pipeline-level factors such as speech generation, streaming, and error propagation across ASR, reasoning, and tool-calling stages, motivating our focus on comparing how human and LLM judges score the same interactions end to end. Our results show that LLM- based evaluation can serve as an effective component of large- scale voice-agent assessment, but that its reliability is metric- and configuration-dependent rather than uniform. This pro- vides an empirical framework for identifying which metrics suit automated evaluation and supports hybrid pipelines in which LLM judges handle scalable assessment while human evaluators remain engaged for metrics that demand contextual interpretation and higher-confidence judgment.

papers.relevance_reason_zh: 评测LLM作为语音Agent评判者的可靠性，属于一般安全评测，按规则不判相关。
papers.title_zh: 对语音代理评估中的LLM评判者进行基准测试：可靠性、校准与人工监督
papers.abstract_zh: 大规模评估对话式语音代理需要既捕捉可观察的交互质量、又体现通常由人类评估者提供的上下文判断的可靠评估方法。我们通过将人类判断与GPT-4.1和GPT-5对电信和零售语音代理对话的评判进行比较，从对话质量和安全维度研究LLM-as-a-Judge评估。相同的交互在三种评估配置p0、p1和p2下进行评分，以测试自动判断是否对评估设置敏感，以及观察到的模式是否能在不同配置和评判模型之间泛化。在总体一致性之外，我们检查指标层面的相关性、评估者一致性以及系统性的“人类-LLM分歧”，以识别哪些对话属性可以被自动化可靠判断，哪些仍然对解释和上下文敏感。有效的语音代理评估还受到流水线层面因素的影响，例如语音生成、流式处理，以及错误在ASR、推理和工具调用各阶段的传播，这促使我们专注于比较人类和LLM评判者如何端到端地对相同交互进行评分。我们的结果表明，基于LLM的评估可以作为大规模语音代理评估的有效组成部分，但其可靠性取决于指标和配置，而非统一的。这提供了一个经验框架，用于识别哪些指标适合自动化评估，并支持混合流水线：LLM评判者负责可扩展的评估，而人类评估者仍参与需要上下文解释和更高置信度判断的指标。

papers.title: 'Ghaib in Translation' aka Unseen Harm: Measuring Cross-Script Safety Inconsistency with 'Missed-in-Urdu' Scores in LLM Hate Speech Detection
papers.abstract: Urdu, the world's tenth most spoken language with 246 million speakers, remains almost entirely absent from mainstream LLM safety evaluation and nine years of WOAH proceedings. To investigate whether this absence has measurable consequences for content moderation reliability, five large language models, GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Qwen-2.5, and Llama-3.1, were tested across six datasets spanning Nastaliq Urdu, Roman Urdu, English, and code-switched Urdu-English. Across the five Urdu-script datasets, label instability between original-script and English-translation classification ranged from 15.9% (Gemini 2.5 Flash) to 31.6% (Qwen-2.5), with a 'Missed-in-Urdu' rate, content flagged as harmful in English translation but passed as normal in the original script, ranging from 2.4% to 9.9% (median 4.3%). A complete enumeration of all 205 papers across nine ALW/WOAH editions via the ACL Anthology API confirms zero dedicated Urdu papers across the entire period. Results indicate that current LLMs provide uneven safety assurance across Urdu's script varieties, with smaller open-weight models showing substantially higher instability and missed-harm rates than frontier closed models.

papers.title_zh: “翻译中的盖伊布”又名“隐形的伤害”：以“乌尔都语漏检”分数衡量大语言模型仇恨言论检测中的跨文字安全不一致性
papers.abstract_zh: 乌尔都语是世界第十大语言，拥有2.46亿使用者，但在主流大语言模型安全评估和九年的WOAH会议论文集中几乎完全缺席。为调查这一缺席是否对内容审核可靠性产生可衡量的影响，研究人员在涵盖Nastaliq体乌尔都语、罗马体乌尔都语、英语及乌尔都语-英语语码转换的六个数据集中，对五个大语言模型（GPT-4o、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Qwen-2.5和Llama-3.1）进行了测试。在五个乌尔都语文字数据集中，原始文字与英文翻译分类之间的标签不稳定性介于15.9%（Gemini 2.5 Flash）至31.6%（Qwen-2.5）之间，其中“乌尔都语漏检”率——即在英文翻译中被标记为有害但在原始文字中被视为正常的内容比例——介于2.4%至9.9%之间（中位数为4.3%）。通过对ACL Anthology API中九个ALW/WOAH版本全部205篇论文的完整枚举，确认整个期间内没有任何一篇专门针对乌尔都语的论文。结果表明，当前大语言模型在乌尔都语的不同文字变体间所提供的安全保证并不均衡，较小规模的开源模型相比前沿闭源模型表现出显著更高的不稳定性和漏检有害内容的比例。

papers.title: Paritok-4B: Intent-Conditioned Context Compression for Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Coding agents re-send large file reads and tool outputs to a frontier LLM every turn, and this context dominates their token bill. General-purpose prompt compressors are trained on prose and suit code poorly: they paraphrase identifiers and drop the exact spans an agent needs to edit. We present Paritok-4B, a 4B LoRA compressor for coding-agent trajectories built on two commitments. It is extractive: it selects spans rather than rewriting them, and 96.0% of the identifiers, paths, and numbers it emits already appear in its input, holding at 96.2% on held-out SWE-bench Lite output. It is intent-conditioned: told the agent's current task, it acts chiefly inside a retained segment, selecting which lines survive (retained lines are +0.067 more intent-relevant than removed ones, paired 95% CI [+0.056, +0.078]) rather than changing how much is retained. We distil a gpt-4.1-mini teacher over 67,074 real OpenHands trajectories into 40,606 validated examples and fine-tune Qwen3-4B. On all 300 SWE-bench Lite instances, Paritok-4B compresses agent context to 25.7% of its size, 2.0x harder than a gpt-4.1-mini compressor (50.2%) and 2.4x harder than gpt-5 (61.9%), while retaining 86.5% of uncompressed single-shot solve quality. Fed the cat -n line-numbered input real agents produce, it compresses slightly less (27.8%) and retains more (89.3%); there the paired test is informative, with 30 instances solved only uncompressed and 17 only compressed, an exact McNemar p=0.079, so at this sample size compressing context to roughly a quarter of its size does not significantly reduce the solve rate. The model is a 264 MB adapter that self-hosts on one 24 GB GPU with no per-token compressor fee, which at list prices decides the economics: gpt-5 as a compressor is net-negative, costing more than the downstream tokens it saves. Weights, data, and evaluation scripts are open (Apache 2.0).

papers.title_zh: Paritok-4B：面向编码代理的意图条件上下文压缩
papers.abstract_zh: 编码代理在每一轮都会将大型文件读取和工具输出重新发送给前沿LLM，而这部分上下文主导了它们的token账单。通用提示压缩器在散文上训练，不适合代码：它们会改写标识符，并丢弃代理需要编辑的确切跨度。我们提出Paritok-4B，一个4B LoRA压缩器，用于编码代理轨迹，建立在两个承诺之上。它是抽取式的：它选择跨度而不是重写它们，并且它输出的标识符、路径和数字中有96.0%已经出现在其输入中，在保留的SWE-bench Lite输出上保持96.2%。它是意图条件的：在被告知代理的当前任务后，它主要在保留的片段内操作，选择哪些行存活（保留的行比移除的行在意图相关性上高+0.067，配对95% CI [+0.056, +0.078]），而不是改变保留多少。我们在67,074条真实OpenHands轨迹上蒸馏了一个gpt-4.1-mini教师模型，得到40,606个经过验证的示例，并微调Qwen3-4B。在所有300个SWE-bench Lite实例上，Paritok-4B将代理上下文压缩到其大小的25.7%，压缩强度是gpt-4.1-mini压缩器（50.2%）的2.0倍，是gpt-5（61.9%）的2.4倍，同时保留了未压缩单次求解质量的86.5%。当输入真实代理产生的带cat -n行号的内容时，它压缩得略少（27.8%），保留得更多（89.3%）；在那里，配对检验具有信息量：30个实例仅未压缩时解决，17个仅压缩时解决，精确McNemar p=0.079，因此在这个样本量下，将上下文压缩到约四分之一大小并不会显著降低解决率。该模型是一个264 MB的适配器，可在单个24 GB GPU上自托管，无需按token支付压缩器费用，这在目录价格下决定了经济性：gpt-5作为压缩器是净负收益，其成本高于其节省的下游token。权重、数据和评估脚本均已开放（Apache 2.0）。

papers.title: Rethinking Pre-Training and Augmentation for Zero-Shot Cross-City Object Detection
papers.abstract: Real-world deployment of traffic surveillance systems is bottlenecked by geographic domain shift, in which models trained in one city underperform when applied to an unseen target city. Conventional domain adaptation relies on hyperparameter-sensitive architectures or direct profiling of target data. Both are fundamentally precluded in privacy-conscious ecosystems that require completely blind training and evaluation loops. In this setting, we explore the effects of pre-training and augmentation in addressing the domain shift problem. Specifically, we propose a new modular training pipeline for object detection structured around two core orthogonal pillars: (1) a multi-dataset pre-training strategy featuring a class-agnostic objectness distillation to decouple structural vehicle geometry from semantic taxonomies, and (2) a domain-resilient augmentation stream featuring a novel Grayworld transformation that forces global attention heads to strip volatile chromatic shortcuts in favor of robust shape priors. When evaluated with the real-time transformer-based detector RF-DETR, our framework bridges cross-city distribution gaps while using limited GPU memory (16GB). Our optimized variants, RF-DETR-HR and RF-DETR-Grayworld, deliver a substantial empirical gain of +24.29 over the baseline, achieving 1st place (47.53 mAP) on the AI City Challenge Track 6 leaderboard. Code and data are available at: \href{https://github.com/SKKUAutoLab/aic26_cross_city}{SKKUAutoLab/aic26\_cross\_city}.

papers.title_zh: 重新思考零样本跨城市目标检测的预训练与数据增强
papers.abstract_zh: 交通监控系统的实际部署受到地理域偏移的瓶颈制约，即在一个城市训练的模型应用于未见过的目标城市时性能下降。传统域适应方法依赖于超参数敏感的架构或对目标数据的直接剖析。在要求完全盲训练和评估循环的隐私敏感型生态系统中，这两种方法从根本上都是不可行的。在此设定下，我们探讨了预训练和数据增强在解决域偏移问题中的效果。具体而言，我们提出了一种新的模块化目标检测训练流程，围绕两个核心正交支柱构建：(1) 一种多数据集预训练策略，采用类别无关的物体性蒸馏，将结构性的车辆几何特征与语义分类体系解耦；(2) 一种域鲁棒增强流，采用新颖的Grayworld变换，迫使全局注意力头舍弃易变的颜色捷径，转而偏好稳健的形状先验。在与实时基于Transformer的检测器RF-DETR一同评估时，我们的框架在有限的GPU内存（16GB）条件下弥合了跨城市分布差距。我们优化的变体RF-DETR-HR和RF-DETR-Grayworld相对于基线取得了+24.29的显著经验增益，在AI City Challenge Track 6排行榜上以47.53 mAP获得第一名。代码和数据可在以下网址获取：\href{https://github.com/SKKUAutoLab/aic26_cross_city}{SKKUAutoLab/aic26_cross_city}。

papers.title: TrustDABench: Benchmarking Reliability and Robustness of LLMs for Structured Data Analysis
papers.abstract: LLMs are increasingly used to analyze spreadsheets, CSV files, and other structured data, but producing a correct-looking answer is not the same as producing a trustworthy analysis. A trustworthy result should be supported by a valid path from the user question to the relevant data evidence. This requirement creates two diagnostic questions: whether an LLM can refuse to answer or ask for clarification when such a path does not exist, and whether it can preserve the correct analysis when the same evidence is expressed in different table forms. We introduce TrustDABench, a benchmark that operationalizes these questions as reliability and robustness. Starting from the evidence-path view, we derive 19 perturbation operators and instantiate them through an Agentic-LLM-based generation framework. TrustDABench contains 2,340 human-verified perturbed instances, and we evaluate eight representative LLMs. The results show substantial headroom: the best reliability result is only 24.21% average MRS, achieved by GPT-5.5, while the best robustness result still has 9.10% average ASR, achieved by Claude-Sonnet-5. The failures are systematic: models rarely detect conflicting evidence, often continue along executable but unsupported analysis paths, and remain sensitive to perturbations that change observation boundaries or cross-table relations. These findings suggest that stronger evidence-boundary recognition and representation-invariant reasoning are still needed for reliable structured-data analysis.

papers.title_zh: TrustDABench：面向结构化数据分析的LLM可靠性与鲁棒性基准评测
papers.abstract_zh: LLM越来越多地被用于分析电子表格、CSV文件和其他结构化数据，但生成一个看起来正确的答案并不等同于生成一份可信的分析。可信的结果应当由一条从用户问题到相关数据证据的有效路径来支撑。这一要求引出了两个诊断性问题：当这样的路径不存在时，LLM能否拒绝回答或请求澄清；以及当相同的证据以不同的表格形式呈现时，LLM能否保持正确的分析。我们提出了TrustDABench，一个将这些操作化为可靠性和鲁棒性指标的基准测试。从证据路径视角出发，我们推导出19个扰动算子，并通过一个基于Agentic-LLM的生成框架对它们进行实例化。TrustDABench包含2,340个人工验证的扰动实例，我们评估了八个具有代表性的LLM。结果表明仍有很大的提升空间：最佳可靠性结果仅达到24.21%的平均MRS，由GPT-5.5取得；而最佳鲁棒性结果仍有9.10%的平均ASR，由Claude-Sonnet-5取得。这些失败是系统性的：模型很少能检测到相互冲突的证据，常常沿着可执行但缺乏支撑的分析路径继续推进，并且对改变观测边界或跨表关系的扰动仍然敏感。这些发现表明，要实现可靠的结构化数据分析，仍然需要更强的证据边界识别能力和表示不变的推理能力。

papers.title: Structured Frequency-Domain Evidence for LLM-Based Time-Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract: Time-series anomalies can appear not only as pointwise deviations but also as changes in recurring temporal structure, such as shifted periodicity or localized oscillatory fluctuations. However, existing LLM-based time-series anomaly detection methods mainly expose time-domain evidence through indexed values, plots, or de-seasonalized representations, leaving spectral structure implicit. We propose an evidence-augmented zero-shot TSAD framework that preserves indexed de-seasonalized observations while adding compact frequency-domain evidence computed with the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). The evidence is constructed at two resolutions: global frequency-domain evidence summarizes sequence-level periodic context, while local frequency-domain evidence captures time-localized spectral departures. Experiments on AnomLLM with InternVL2-LLaMA3-76B, Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct, Gemini-2.5-Flash, and GPT-4o, together with evaluation on the TSB-AD-U subset, show that explicit frequency-domain evidence improves LLM-based TSAD baselines. These results suggest that frequency-domain evidence can complement indexed and de-seasonalized time-domain inputs for zero-shot LLM-based TSAD.

papers.title_zh: 用于基于LLM的时间序列异常检测的结构化频域证据
papers.abstract_zh: 时间序列异常不仅可能表现为逐点偏差，还可能表现为重复出现的时间结构的变化，例如偏移的周期性或局部振荡波动。然而，现有的基于LLM的时间序列异常检测方法主要通过索引值、图或去季节化表示来暴露时域证据，使得频谱结构隐含其中。我们提出了一种证据增强的零样本TSAD框架，该框架在保留索引化的去季节化观测值的同时，添加了使用快速傅里叶变换(FFT)计算的紧凑频域证据。该证据以两种分辨率构建：全局频域证据概括序列级周期性上下文，而局部频域证据捕获时间局部化的频谱偏离。在AnomLLM上使用InternVL2-LLaMA3-76B、Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct、Gemini-2.5-Flash和GPT-4o进行的实验，以及在TSB-AD-U子集上的评估表明，显式频域证据改进了基于LLM的TSAD基线。这些结果表明，对于零样本基于LLM的TSAD，频域证据可以补充索引化和去季节化的时域输入。

papers.title: RetrievalFormer: A Dual-Encoder Transformer for Efficient Approximate Nearest Neighbor Retrieval and Cold-Item Recommendation
papers.abstract: A shared search-and-recommendation index must score new items from features alone because search has no exploration slot. In a public log covering both surfaces over one catalog, $38.6\%$ of held-out query-search impressions show an item never previously shown or visited. For user-cold engagements, the feature-based tower serves this demand without measurable loss against $99$ sampled negatives ($0.9595$ Recall@20 versus $0.9510$ warm). A lexical baseline reaches similar parity, while a full-catalog check remains statistically undecided. Dual-encoder retrieval therefore keeps the index \emph{open} to new items, unlike an ID-softmax recommender that requires retraining. We price this openness on recommendation against six sequential baselines, each retrained and tuned through five rounds on corrected targets. A float32 timestamp bug had reordered leave-one-out targets for $19.7\%$ of users. On MovieLens-1M, warm accuracy trails the strongest retrained baseline by $5.2\%$ Recall@20 and $11.4\%$ NDCG@20. On MIND, the gap narrows to $0.8$--$3.6\%$ relative to the five strongest baselines, though the model ranks sixth of seven. Under strict zero-leakage cold-start evaluation, the content tower achieves $0.172 \pm 0.006$ Recall@20, $1.4\times$ the strongest retrained dedicated method ($0.124 \pm 0.007$) and $3\times$ a training-free floor, without cold-specific training. Exact full-softmax training raises Recall@20 by $54\%$ on MIND-small and $6.9\%$ on MovieLens-1M over sampled InfoNCE, but recomputes the full catalog each step and exhausts accelerator memory at $240$K items. Approximate nearest-neighbor search explains none of the remaining gap, serving cost does not regress against ID-softmax retrieval, and a history-window sweep explains half the post-recipe remainder. Exact-quality training at catalog scale remains the open problem.
