papers.title_zh: RetrievalFormer：一种用于高效近似最近邻检索和冷物品推荐的双编码器Transformer
papers.abstract_zh: 共享的搜索和推荐索引必须仅根据特征对新物品进行评分，因为搜索没有探索位。在覆盖同一目录上两个界面的公开日志中，$38.6\%$ 的留出查询-搜索曝光显示了一个先前从未展示或访问过的物品。对于用户冷交互，基于特征的塔在$99$个采样负样本下服务此需求，且没有可衡量的损失（$0.9595$ Recall@20 对比 $0.9510$ 热启动）。一个词法基线达到相似的水平，而全目录检查在统计上仍无定论。因此，双编码器检索使索引对新物品保持“开放”，不同于需要重新训练的ID-softmax推荐器。我们在推荐上衡量了这种开放性的代价，与六个序列基线对比，每个基线都在修正后的目标上经过五轮重新训练和调优。一个float32时间戳错误曾对$19.7\%$的用户重新排序了留一法目标。在MovieLens-1M上，热启动准确率落后于最强重新训练基线$5.2\%$ Recall@20和$11.4\%$ NDCG@20。在MIND上，相对于五个最强基线，差距缩小到$0.8$--$3.6\%$，尽管模型在七个中排名第六。在严格的零泄漏冷启动评估下，内容塔实现了$0.172 \pm 0.006$ Recall@20，是最强重新训练专用方法（$0.124 \pm 0.007$）的$1.4\times$倍，是无训练下限的$3\times$倍，且无需针对冷启动的专门训练。精确的全softmax训练在MIND-small上将Recall@20提高了$54\%$，在MovieLens-1M上比采样InfoNCE提高了$6.9\%$，但每一步都重新计算整个目录，并在$240$K物品时耗尽加速器内存。近似最近邻搜索无法解释剩余的差距，服务成本相对于ID-softmax检索并无退化，而历史窗口扫描解释了方案后剩余差距的一半。目录规模下的精确质量训练仍然是未解决的问题。

papers.title: Evaluating Language Models on Cross-Language Code Functional Equivalence
papers.abstract: Background: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance across a variety of code-understanding tasks, leading many to believe that they can reason about program semantics. However, existing evaluations primarily focus on single-language settings or rely on synthetically generated code, raising concerns about whether current results reflect true semantic understanding. Aims: We investigate whether LLMs can accurately judge functional equivalence across different programming languages in human-written code, a setting that requires deeper reasoning beyond superficial similarity. Method: We introduce PolyHuman, a dataset of human-written programs in CPP, Java, and Python. Using this dataset, we evaluate intra- and inter-language equivalence detection across open-weight and proprietary LLMs, selecting GPT-o4-mini as a representative model to assess stability. We then manually analyze 81 cases of systematic disagreement in which models incorrectly judge functional equivalence, examining the code logic and the generated Chain-of-Thought reasoning. Finally, we categorize these failures and compare them across GPT-o4-mini, Claude-Opus-4.7, and Gemini-3-Flash to determine whether they reflect model-specific issues or broader limitations of state-of-the-art LLMs. Results: We identify a difficulty-dependent breakdown in equivalence judgment (harder problems make the model increasingly prone to misclassifying non-equivalent code as equivalent), a model-specific sensitivity to programming language for the best-performing model (particularly a more conservative behavior on Python), and a partial reliance on similarity-based cues. GPT-o4-mini also shows substantial run-to-run instability under identical settings, indicating inconsistent rather than absent capability. Conclusions: Current LLMs do not reliably capture functional equivalence within or across languages.

papers.title_zh: 跨语言代码功能等价性上的语言模型评估
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：大型语言模型（LLMs）在各类代码理解任务中表现出色，导致许多人认为它们能够对程序语义进行推理。然而，现有评估主要集中于单语言设置或依赖合成生成的代码，这引发了对当前结果是否反映真正语义理解的担忧。目的：我们研究LLMs是否能在人类编写的代码中准确判断跨编程语言的功能等价性，这一设置需要超越表面相似性的更深层推理。方法：我们引入了PolyHuman，一个包含CPP、Java和Python人类编写程序的数据集。利用该数据集，我们评估了开放权重和专有LLMs在语言内和语言间等价性检测上的表现，并选择GPT-o4-mini作为代表性模型以评估稳定性。然后，我们人工分析了81个模型错误判断功能等价性的系统性分歧案例，检查代码逻辑和生成的Chain-of-Thought推理。最后，我们对这些失败进行分类，并在GPT-o4-mini、Claude-Opus-4.7和Gemini-3-Flash之间进行比较，以确定它们反映的是模型特有的问题，还是最先进LLMs的普遍局限。结果：我们发现等价性判断存在依赖难度的失效（问题越难，模型越倾向于将不等价代码误判为等价），最佳模型对编程语言存在模型特有的敏感性（尤其是在Python上表现更为保守），以及部分依赖基于相似性的线索。GPT-o4-mini在相同设置下还表现出显著的运行间不稳定性，表明其能力不一致而非缺失。结论：当前的LLMs无法可靠地捕捉语言内部或跨语言的功能等价性。

papers.title: Multi-Modal Semantic Expansion with Constrained LLM Reranking for Conversational Music Recommendation
papers.abstract: We present Team Semiintelligencn's solution for the ACM RecSys 2026 TalkPlayData Challenge, addressing conversational music recommendation through a multi-modal and personalized conversational recommender system. Our submitted system employs a three-stage pipeline: (1) multi-modal retrieval constructing decay-weighted centroids across seven dense embedding spaces - track- and user-level CF-BPR, Qwen3 (metadata, lyrics, attributes), CLAP audio, and SigLIP visual - supplemented by BM25 lexical retrieval and an artist substring-match signal, all fused via weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) with optimized signal weights; (2) lightweight reranking (history filtering, popularity smoothing, and catalog diversity penalization); and (3) persona-diversified response generation using GPT-4o-mini. Beyond this submitted configuration, we report development-time experiments with additional components - constrained LLM-guided artist injection, album continuation signals, XGBoost LambdaMART, and a superior GPT-4.1 response prompt - that were not deployed to Blind B due to cost and complexity constraints. We optimize RRF weights on a 500-session development split via differential evolution, improving MRR by +19.5%. On Blind A, we observe that unconstrained LLM-guided injection across 54 sessions causes catastrophic nDCG regression (-18.9%), while conservative injection on only 9 sessions yields the best observed Blind A nDCG - a finding we present as a Blind A observation warranting further validation. The submitted system achieves a Blind B composite score of 0.3213.

papers.title_zh: 用于对话式音乐推荐的多模态语义扩展与约束大语言模型重排序
papers.abstract_zh: 我们展示了 Team Semiintelligencn 针对 ACM RecSys 2026 TalkPlayData Challenge 的解决方案，通过多模态和个性化的对话式推荐系统解决对话式音乐推荐问题。我们提交的系统采用三阶段流水线：（1）多模态检索，在七个稠密嵌入空间上构建衰减加权质心——轨道级和用户级 CF-BPR、Qwen3（元数据、歌词、属性）、CLAP 音频和 SigLIP 视觉——辅以 BM25 词法检索和艺术家子串匹配信号，全部通过加权倒数融合（RRF）并采用优化后的信号权重进行融合；（2）轻量级重排序（历史过滤、流行度平滑和目录多样性惩罚）；（3）使用 GPT-4o-mini 进行个性化多样化的回复生成。除提交的配置外，我们还报告了开发阶段的额外组件实验——受约束的 LLM 引导的艺术家注入、专辑延续信号、XGBoost LambdaMART 以及更优的 GPT-4.1 回复提示——这些由于成本和复杂性限制未部署到 Blind B。我们在 500 个会话的开发划分上通过差分进化优化 RRF 权重，将 MRR 提升了 +19.5%。在 Blind A 上，我们观察到在 54 个会话上进行无约束的 LLM 引导注入会导致灾难性的 nDCG 回归（-18.9%），而仅在 9 个会话上进行保守注入则获得了观察到的 Blind A 最佳 nDCG——我们将这一发现作为有待进一步验证的 Blind A 观察结果呈现。提交的系统在 Blind B 上取得了 0.3213 的综合得分。

papers.title: How Useful are LLMs for Grammar Engineering? Cantonese ParGram Resources and Controlled Experimental Evaluation with English Baselines
papers.abstract: This paper presents new Cantonese ParGram resources and evaluates LLMs for knowledge-driven grammar engineering within a controlled experimental paradigm. Using Cantonese ParGram resources as gold standards, with corresponding English baselines, we investigate whether OpenAI's gpt-oss-120b and GPT-5.4 can generate machine-processable grammars from sentences and target formal structures under systematically varied prompting conditions. GPT-5.4 outperformed gpt-oss-120b, while grammars generated from target formal structures generally outperformed those generated from sentences. Although both models could generate locally plausible phrase-structure rules, lexical entries, and templates, they often struggled to coordinate interacting formal constraints, especially in multi-construction settings. The results characterize both the capabilities and limitations of current LLMs for potential integration into AI-assisted expert workflows: LLMs may support intermediate stages of grammar development, but human linguistic expertise remains central to analysis, validation, and refinement. The study also contributes new Cantonese symbolic grammatical resources.

papers.title_zh: 大语言模型对语法工程的用处有多大？粤语ParGram资源及与英语基线的受控实验评估
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了新的粤语ParGram资源，并在受控实验范式下评估了大语言模型在知识驱动语法工程中的表现。以粤语ParGram资源为金标准，并辅以相应的英语基线，我们研究了OpenAI的gpt-oss-120b和GPT-5.4能否在系统变化的提示条件下，从句子和目标形式结构生成机器可处理的语法。GPT-5.4的表现优于gpt-oss-120b，而从目标形式结构生成的语法总体上优于从句子生成的语法。尽管两个模型都能生成局部合理的短语结构规则、词条和模板，但它们往往难以协调相互作用的正式约束，尤其是在多构式设置中。结果刻画了当前大语言模型在潜在融入AI辅助专家工作流程方面的能力与局限：大语言模型可能支持语法开发的中间阶段，但人类语言学专业知识仍然在分析、验证和细化中发挥核心作用。该研究还贡献了新的粤语符号语法资源。

papers.title: ChebBooster: A Training-Free Approach for Efficient Diffusion Transformer Inference via Chebyshev-Inspired Extrapolation
papers.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have shown strong performance in high-fidelity image generation, but their sampling process remains computationally intensive due to full model execution at every timestep. While cache-based acceleration has been explored to mitigate inference cost, naive reuse schemes suffer from low accuracy over long intervals, and Taylor-series-based extrapolation methods often face instability caused by Runge oscillations. In this paper, we propose ChebBooster, a training-free extrapolation framework based on Chebyshev polynomial theory that achieves stable and efficient acceleration for DiTs. Specifically, we adopt the Barycentric formulation to evaluate Chebyshev approximants with high numerical stability and minimal overhead, and further decouple the extrapolation into an offline weight precomputation phase and a lightweight online application stage. Extensive experiments across three representative DiT-based models, including DiT-XL/2, PixArt-$Σ$, and FLUX.1-dev, demonstrate that ChebBooster achieves consistent improvements in visual quality and inference efficiency, reaching up to $3.68\times$ latency speedup and $5.12\times$ FLOPs reduction, outperforming existing training-free baselines under diverse generation tasks and resolutions.

papers.title_zh: ChebBooster：一种基于切比雪夫启发外推的无训练高效扩散Transformer推理方法
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散Transformer（DiTs）在高保真图像生成中展现出强大性能，但由于每个时间步都需要执行完整模型，其采样过程仍然计算密集。尽管已探索基于缓存的加速来缓解推理成本，但朴素的复用方案在长间隔内精度较低，而基于泰勒级数的外推方法常面临由龙格振荡引起的不稳定性。在本文中，我们提出ChebBooster，一种基于切比雪夫多项式理论的无训练外推框架，可为DiTs实现稳定且高效的加速。具体而言，我们采用重心插值公式来评估切比雪夫逼近式，具有高数值稳定性和极低开销，并进一步将外推解耦为离线权重预计算阶段和轻量级在线应用阶段。在三个具有代表性的基于DiT的模型（包括DiT-XL/2、PixArt-$\Sigma$和FLUX.1-dev）上进行的大量实验表明，ChebBooster在视觉质量和推理效率方面均取得了一致的改进，实现了高达$3.68\times$的延迟加速和$5.12\times$的FLOPs减少，在多种生成任务和分辨率下优于现有的无训练基线方法。

papers.title: A Comprehensive Analysis of Arabic Natural Language Processing Research: Trends, Topic Evolution, and Research Gaps -- A Bibliometric and Topic-Based Study
papers.abstract: Natural Language Processing (NLP) has grown rapidly over the past decade, driven by digital transformation in the Arab world, social media, and large language models (LLMs). Despite this growth, a comprehensive quantitative meta-analysis of the field remains absent. This study presents a large-scale bibliometric and topic-based analysis of 7,120 Arabic NLP papers published between 1960 and 2026, sourced from six collections. We employ BERTopic for topic modeling, regression analysis to identify citation predictors, social network analysis for co-authorship structures, and geographic mapping. Our findings show a significant publication surge after 2020, driven by transformer models and LLMs. Topic modeling identifies 19 substantive themes, the largest centered on text, speech, translation, and recognition. Citation analysis reveals a positive correlation between paper age and citations (r = 0.245, p < 0.001); regression shows that indexing in OpenAlex or Semantic Scholar and institutional affiliation are associated with higher citation counts. Saudi Arabia, the United States, and Egypt lead in research output. A task-dialect gap matrix identifies critical understudied areas, including summarization for Maghrebi, Iraqi, and Sudanese dialects. The largest topic has the highest H-index (87), followed by sentiment analysis (54). Our quantitative approach complements existing qualitative surveys and offers recommendations to prioritize under-resourced dialects and develop culturally aligned benchmarks for Arabic NLP.

papers.title_zh: 阿拉伯语自然语言处理研究的综合分析：趋势、主题演变与研究空白——一项文献计量与主题研究
papers.abstract_zh: 自然语言处理（NLP）在过去十年中发展迅速，其驱动力来自阿拉伯世界的数字化转型、社交媒体以及大型语言模型（LLMs）。尽管取得了这一增长，但对该领域的全面定量元分析仍然缺失。本研究对1960年至2026年间发表的7,120篇阿拉伯语NLP论文进行了大规模文献计量和基于主题的分析，这些论文来源于六个文献集合。我们采用BERTopic进行主题建模，使用回归分析来识别引文预测因素，利用社交网络分析考察合著结构，并进行了地理映射。我们的研究结果显示，2020年之后论文发表量显著激增，这一激增由Transformer模型和大型语言模型驱动。主题建模识别出19个实质性主题，其中最大的主题集中于文本、语音、翻译和识别。引文分析揭示了论文年龄与引文数量之间的正相关关系（r = 0.245, p < 0.001）；回归分析表明，被OpenAlex或Semantic Scholar索引以及机构归属与更高的引文数量相关。沙特阿拉伯、美国和埃及在研究产出方面处于领先地位。任务-方言差距矩阵识别出关键的研究不足领域，包括针对马格里布、伊拉克和苏丹方言的摘要生成。最大的主题拥有最高的H指数（87），其次是情感分析（54）。我们的定量方法补充了现有的定性综述，并提出了优先支持资源不足方言以及为阿拉伯语NLP开发符合文化背景基准的建议。

papers.title: Photorealistic Novel View Synthesis of Human Faces using Next-Scale Transformers
papers.abstract: Photorealistic novel view synthesis of people remains challenging at high spatial resolutions and across multiple target cameras, where preserving identity, fine appearance details, and geometric coherence is critical. We build on the next-scale autoregressive paradigm and adapt it for human-centric view synthesis by enabling higher image resolutions, multi-view outputs and stronger cross-view consistency in a single forward pass. We train on a synthetic dataset of human faces spanning diverse identities and apparel. Contrary to diffusion models, this paradigm does not need 2D pre-training and, thanks to its next-scale architecture, it benefits from lower-resolution, general-purpose pre-trainings, with the full-sized purpose-specific images being used only in the last training stages. This enables our architecture to converge with a smaller amount of purpose-specific training data, allowing us to use a smaller but more realistic training dataset. The resulting model produces sharp and realistic views, with the option to synthesize multiple novel viewpoints simultaneously for improved agreement across views. Empirically, we observe gains in perceptual fidelity and cross-view coherence on human subjects, demonstrating that next-scale autoregression is an effective backbone for scalable, multi-output human view synthesis. We also couple our pipeline with an existing transformer-based model for pixel-aligned 3D gaussian lifting from multi-view facial inputs, resulting in accurate and photorealistic 3D models of human faces.

papers.title_zh: 使用下一尺度变换器实现人脸照片级真实感新视角合成
papers.abstract_zh: 在较高空间分辨率和多个目标相机下，人物的照片级真实感新视角合成仍然具有挑战性，此时保持身份、精细外观细节和几何一致性至关重要。我们基于下一尺度自回归范式，通过实现更高图像分辨率、多视角输出以及单次前向传播中更强的跨视角一致性，将其适配于以人为中心的视角合成。我们在一个涵盖多样身份和服装的人脸合成数据集上训练。与扩散模型不同，该范式无需二维预训练，并且得益于其下一尺度架构，可以从较低分辨率、通用目的的预训练中受益，而全尺寸特定用途图像仅在最后训练阶段使用。这使我们的架构能够以较少的特定用途训练数据收敛，从而使我们能够使用更小但更逼真的训练数据集。由此产生的模型能够生成清晰且逼真的视角，并可选择同时合成多个新视角以提高跨视角一致性。实验上，我们观察到在人物主体上的感知保真度和跨视角一致性有所提升，表明下一尺度自回归是用于可扩展、多输出人物视角合成的有效主干。我们还将我们的流程与现有的基于变换器的模型相结合，用于从多视角面部输入进行像素对齐的3D高斯提升，从而生成准确且照片级真实感的人脸3D模型。

papers.title: A Threshold Homomorphic Blockchain Architecture for Secure and Scalable IoT Sensor Data Aggregation
papers.abstract: Homomorphic-encryption blockchain frameworks for IoT sensor aggregation generally rely on classical cryptographic hardness assumptions and seldom account for network topology in liveness and performance analysis. This work introduces Phi-PHE-BC, a topology-aware homomorphic blockchain architecture for secure and privacy-preserving IoT sensor data aggregation. The framework combines threshold Paillier decryption with graph-parameterized security and performance analysis, linking protocol behavior to the validator graph. On-chain Paillier ciphertexts support homomorphic aggregation while providing IND-CPA confidentiality under the Decisional Composite Residuosity assumption, and authentication signatures provide EUF-CMA transaction integrity. Threshold partial-decryption shares are protected by a noise-flooding wrapper that provides information-theoretic privacy under the configured statistical-hiding condition. Under partial synchrony and Byzantine fault-tolerance assumptions, liveness requires validator connectivity kappa(Gv) >= f+1. We derive topology-dependent throughput bounds for tree, star, mesh, and scale-free networks, together with a per-block communication-cost model. A game-theoretic analysis shows that honest validator participation is a dominant strategy under the stated utility model, yielding an all-honest Nash equilibrium. Experiments on Hyperledger Fabric 2.5 show lower end-to-end latency than the selected traditional PHE-blockchain baseline while maintaining controllable threshold-decryption overhead. Results across topology scaling, validator sensitivity, threshold decryption, and Byzantine-load experiments indicate that Phi-PHE-BC is a practical architecture for secure, privacy-preserving, and topology-aware IoT sensor aggregation.

papers.summary_zh:
## 一句话结论
Phi-PHE-BC 是一种将阈值同态加密（threshold homomorphic encryption）与区块链相结合的拓扑感知（topology-aware）架构，用于在 IoT 传感器数据聚合中同时实现机密性、完整性与可扩展性。

## 问题与动机
现有同态加密区块链框架通常依赖经典密码学困难性假设，并且在活性（liveness）与性能分析中很少考虑网络拓扑。这导致协议行为与实际验证者网络结构脱节，难以准确评估安全性和性能边界。Phi-PHE-BC 试图弥补这一缺口。

## 方法与技术路线
- **研究对象与设定**：面向 IoT 传感器数据聚合场景，构建由验证者图（validator graph）驱动的区块链协议。协议行为通过图参数化（graph-parameterized）方式与验证者网络结构关联。
- **输入与链上表示**：传感器数据经 Paillier 加密后以密文形式上链。链上 Paillier 密文支持同态聚合，使聚合操作无需解密原始数据。安全性基于 Decisional Composite Residuosity（DCR）假设，提供 IND-CPA 机密性；认证签名提供 EUF-CMA 交易完整性。
- **阈值解密与隐私保护**：采用阈值 Paillier 解密（threshold Paillier decryption）。部分解密份额由“噪声泛滥”包装器（noise-flooding wrapper）保护，在设定的统计隐藏条件下提供信息论隐私。摘要未说明阈值的具体门限值或噪声参数设置。
- **活性与容错条件**：在部分同步（partial synchrony）和拜占庭容错假设下，活性要求验证者连通性 κ(G_v) ≥ f+1，其中 f 是拜占庭故障节点数。摘要未说明具体共识协议细节。
- **性能建模与分析**：针对树、星、网格、无标度网络导出了拓扑相关的吞吐界，并给出每区块通信成本模型。博弈论分析表明，在既定效用模型下，诚实验证者参与是主导策略，可形成全诚实纳什均衡（all-honest Nash equilibrium）。
- **实验对比**：在 Hyperledger Fabric 2.5 上实现，并与传统 PHE-blockchain 基线比较。实验涵盖拓扑扩展、验证者敏感性、阈值解密和拜占庭负载等场景，但摘要未披露具体数据集、参数规模和延迟数值。

## 主要结果
实验结果表明 Phi-PHE-BC 的端到端延迟低于所选传统 PHE-blockchain 基线，同时阈值解密开销保持在可控范围内。拓扑扩展、验证者敏感性、阈值解密和拜占庭负载实验均支持其作为实用架构的可行性。

## 为什么与兴趣相关
该工作将网络拓扑显式纳入同态区块链协议的安全与性能分析，为隐私保护的 IoT 数据聚合提供了新的设计思路，尤其适合关注隐私计算、同态加密与区块链结合的研究者。摘要未说明具体协议参数与实验配置，如需深入了解需阅读全文。

papers.title: Modalities Should Talk to Each Other: Dual-Stream Multimodal Learning for Long-Horizon Influenza Forecasting
papers.abstract: Forecasting long-range influenza-like illness (ILI) matters for public health readiness. Publicly available surveillance datasets typically pair numeric epidemiological signals with textual information that is noisy, loosely structured, only indirectly related to near-term trends, and often lagged relative to the numeric signal. Fusing the two therefore requires careful design. We propose Dual-Stream Attention (DSA), a multimodal deep learning framework that forecasts 12-week-ahead ILI activity from a 36-week multimodal history by letting the numerical and textual streams condition each other. Using the Time-MMD health-domain dataset, DSA separately encodes the two modalities with a Transformer-based numerical encoder and a domain-adapted headline encoder, then couples them through a bidirectional Cross-Modal Attention (CMA) mechanism: the text (news headlines) conditions the interpretation of the numeric signal and vice versa. The CMA output then passes to a causal temporal model for forecasting. Evaluated across ten random seeds, DSA achieves a median test MSE of 0.416, versus 0.668, 0.607, and 0.851 for iTransformer, TaTS, and GPT4MTS, corresponding to mean-error reductions of 54.95%, 37.29%, and 67.23%, with paired Cohen's d of 0.555, 0.337, and 0.345, respectively, and ranks first in 100% of bootstrap draws. It also has substantially lower worst-window error than all baselines. On an external-geography dataset, DSA again ranks first among nine evaluated baselines. Ablations show the advantage does not depend on text-encoder choice or language-model fine-tuning, and that bidirectional attention outperforms either direction alone. Finally, perturbation-based faithfulness analysis shows the learned CMA is functionally informative under targeted masking, with a stronger effect in the text-to-numerical direction.

papers.title_zh: 模态之间应当相互对话：用于长期流感预测的双流多模态学习
papers.abstract_zh: 长期流感样疾病（ILI）预测对公共卫生准备具有重要意义。公开可用的监测数据集通常将数值流行病学信号与文本信息配对，而文本信息往往嘈杂、结构松散、与近期趋势仅间接相关，且通常相对于数值信号存在滞后。因此，融合这两类信息需要精心的设计。我们提出了双流注意力（DSA），一种多模态深度学习框架，通过让数值流和文本流相互条件化，从36周的多模态历史数据预测未来12周的ILI活动。使用Time-MMD健康领域数据集，DSA分别用基于Transformer的数值编码器和领域自适应标题编码器对两种模态进行编码，然后通过双向跨模态注意力（CMA）机制将它们耦合：文本（新闻标题）条件化数值信号的解读，反之亦然。随后，CMA输出传入一个因果时序模型进行预测。在十个随机种子上的评估中，DSA实现了0.416的中位测试MSE，而iTransformer、TaTS和GPT4MTS分别为0.668、0.607和0.851，对应平均误差降低54.95%、37.29%和67.23%，配对Cohen's d分别为0.555、0.337和0.345，并在100%的bootstrap抽样中排名第一。它的最差窗口误差也显著低于所有基线。在外部地理数据集上，DSA在九个评估基线中再次排名第一。消融实验表明，该优势不依赖于文本编码器的选择或语言模型的微调，并且双向注意力优于任何单一方向。最后，基于扰动的忠实度分析表明，学习到的CMA在定向掩蔽下具有功能信息性，且在文本到数值方向上效果更强。

papers.title: Beyond Point Predictions: Uncertainty-Aware Satellite Poverty Mapping for Public Policy
papers.abstract: Despite their critical importance for policy and research, high-resolution poverty data remain limited across much of Africa. Machine learning (ML) with earth observation (EO) imagery has recently emerged as a way to supplement these data by predicting (i.e., estimating) poverty where it has not been directly measured. Yet to be used reliably, decision-makers and analysts need assurances that they will not be misled by the errors in these predictions. To meet this need, we develop an uncertainty-aware EO-ML method for poverty mapping based on simultaneous quantile regression and a novel form of conformal prediction. Using a spatiotemporal transformer trained on sequences of Landsat and nighttime-light images, we produce prediction intervals for neighborhood-level International Wealth Index estimates across Africa which are statistically guaranteed to achieve their desired coverage rates. While our method's point-prediction performance matches the state of the art, its prediction intervals are wider than might be expected given its high $R^2$ of $0.75$. However, other models of similar accuracy likely suffer from comparable uncertainty, pointing to an inherent limitation: even with its remarkably high explanatory power, EO-ML cannot naively be relied upon for policy-making, such as when designing poverty-targeting programs. To handle this challenge, we develop a procedure to efficiently allocate aid using both ground-truth surveys and model predictions while provably ensuring the risk of excluding eligible neighborhoods remains below a prespecified level. In simulations, this approach delivers substantially more aid per eligible recipient than other strategies, thereby demonstrating that EO-ML can indeed be a reliable supplement to traditional data sources---as long as methods

papers.title_zh: 超越点预测：面向公共政策的不确定性感知卫星贫困制图
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管贫困数据对政策和研究至关重要，但非洲大部分地区的高分辨率贫困数据仍然有限。基于地球观测（EO）影像的机器学习（ML）最近成为一种补充这些数据的方式，通过在未直接测量的地方预测（即估计）贫困状况。然而，若要可靠使用，决策者和分析人员需要得到保证，不会被这些预测中的错误所误导。为满足这一需求，我们开发了一种基于同时分位数回归和一种新颖的保形预测形式的不确定性感知EO-ML贫困制图方法。利用在Landsat和夜间灯光影像序列上训练的时空Transformer，我们为非洲社区级别的国际财富指数估计生成预测区间，这些区间在统计上保证达到其期望的覆盖率。虽然我们方法的点预测性能与最先进水平相当，但考虑到其0.75的高R²，其预测区间比预期更宽。然而，其他精度相近的模型可能也存在类似的不确定性，这表明存在一个固有的局限性：即使具有非常高的解释力，EO-ML也不能被天真地依赖用于政策制定，例如在设计扶贫项目时。为了应对这一挑战，我们开发了一种程序，利用地面实况调查和模型预测来高效分配援助，同时可证明地确保将合格社区排除在外的风险低于预设水平。在模拟中，与其他策略相比，这种方法为每个合格受助者提供了更多的援助，从而表明EO-ML确实可以成为传统数据源的可靠补充——只要方法

papers.title: Sigmoid Attention as a Better Substrate for Learned KV Cache Eviction
papers.abstract: Learned KV-cache eviction often faces a soft-to-hard mismatch: during training, differentiable gates typically attenuate token contributions, whereas inference saves memory only when KV entries are physically removed. We ask whether the attention substrate affects this soft-to-hard transition. Using GPT-2-scale Transformers trained on OpenWebText, we run a controlled $2\times2\times2$ comparison over attention type, learned gating, and positional encoding. Although sigmoid attention is worse as a dense language model, learned hard eviction changes the useful operating points: sigmoid-gated models delete KV entries with negligible PPL change relative to their own no-eviction references. Under a matched live-cache protocol on the same dense backbones, learned sigmoid gates obtain lower PPL than our H$_2$O and KeyDiff implementations, whereas softmax gates do not uniformly beat these post-hoc methods. The results suggest that attention normalization can substantially affect whether a training-time soft gate transfers cleanly to hard KV deletion.

papers.title_zh: Sigmoid注意力作为学习型KV缓存驱逐的更好基底
papers.abstract_zh: 学习型KV缓存驱逐常常面临软到硬的不匹配：在训练期间，可微门通常衰减token的贡献，而在推理时，只有当KV条目被物理移除时才能节省内存。我们探究注意力基底是否影响这种软到硬的转换。使用在OpenWebText上训练的GPT-2规模Transformer，我们针对注意力类型、学习门控和位置编码进行了受控的$2\times2\times2$比较。尽管sigmoid注意力作为密集语言模型时表现更差，但学习型硬驱逐改变了有用的工作点：sigmoid门控模型删除KV条目时，相对于其自身的无驱逐参考，PPL变化可忽略不计。在相同密集骨干网络上的匹配实时缓存协议下，学习型sigmoid门获得的PPL低于我们的H$_2$O和KeyDiff实现，而softmax门并不一致地胜过这些事后方法。结果表明，注意力归一化可以显著影响训练时的软门是否能够干净地迁移到硬KV删除。

papers.title: A Multidimensional Data-Driven Hybrid Transformer Framework for Non-invasive Continuous Blood Pressure Prediction
papers.abstract: Objective. To develop and evaluate a cuffless continuous blood pressure (BP) estimator using temporal physiological and demographic features. We propose a hybrid Transformer framework to estimate diastolic and systolic BP from ECG/PPG-derived feature sequences. Approach. Rather than raw waveforms, the framework models 10-step sequences of six physiological descriptors and two demographic covariates. A Multi-Source Temporal Encoder Module combines Transformer, Kolmogorov-Arnold Network, and XGBoost branches to capture complementary temporal, nonlinear, and tabular information. A Dynamic Conditional Fusion-Decoder applies differential multi-head attention, token-weighted aggregation, and gated residual correction. A robust composite objective jointly optimizes DBP and SBP. Main results. Using the MIMIC-III Waveform and Clinical Databases, the source pool comprised 28,486 waveform segments from 203 subjects, and feature generation retained 53,621 observations from 166 subjects. On 2,431 segment-level held-out test windows, mean error +/- standard deviation was 0.41 +/- 3.74 mmHg for diastolic BP and -1.60 +/- 5.95 mmHg for systolic BP, with 95% limits of agreement of [-6.93, 7.74] and [-13.25, 10.06] mmHg, respectively. The proportions within 10 mmHg were 98.48% and 94.36%. The framework achieved the lowest standard deviations and narrowest limits of agreement among the locally retrained baselines. Significance. The feature-sequence fusion framework improved agreement with reference BP and fell within numerical AAMI and BHS Grade A thresholds on this split. This retrospective analysis is not formal device validation; subject-disjoint and external evaluation remain necessary before clinical use.

papers.title: AI Surrogate Modeling for Real-Time Tokamak Equilibrium Prediction: Benchmarking Neural Architectures and Validation on EXL-50U
papers.abstract: Fast and reliable plasma equilibrium prediction is essential for real-time tokamak operation and control, but conventional Grad-Shafranov (GS) solvers are often too costly for real-time deployment. We develop an AI surrogate framework and benchmark five architectures (MLP, CNN, FNO, Transformer, and KAN) on a numerical GS database with 100,000 IID and 10,000 OOD samples. Under a unified protocol, we evaluate accuracy, inference efficiency, model scaling, and robustness. We also establish device-level validation on the EXL-50U tokamak by linking numerical GS solutions, surrogate predictions, and the standard Shape Editor reference to assess simulation-to-device consistency. The surrogates achieve errors of $10^{-3}$-$10^{-2}$ relative to GS solutions, while the GS-to-device discrepancy remains at $10^{-3}$. Transformer gives the best IID accuracy, whereas CNN offers the best balance of accuracy, robustness, and speed, reaching 0.7 ms TensorRT latency. On unseen plasma geometries and parameter regimes, CNN and FNO show the strongest extrapolation stability, with 4%-5% relative $L_2$ error, while models with weaker inductive biases degrade more substantially. Scaling data and model capacity improves interpolation but not necessarily extrapolation, revealing a trade-off between capacity and OOD generalization. Overall, this work provides a systematic, device-consistent benchmark for AI-based GS prediction and practical guidance for selecting reliable surrogates for real-time plasma control and fusion applications.

papers.title_zh: 用于实时托卡马克平衡预测的AI代理建模：神经架构基准测试及EXL-50U上的验证
papers.abstract_zh: 快速可靠的等离子体平衡预测对于实时托卡马克运行和控制至关重要，但传统的Grad-Shafranov（GS）求解器往往因计算成本过高而难以满足实时部署需求。我们开发了一个AI代理框架，并在包含100,000个IID样本和10,000个OOD样本的数值GS数据库上，对五种架构（MLP、CNN、FNO、Transformer和KAN）进行了基准测试。在统一协议下，我们评估了准确性、推理效率、模型扩展性和鲁棒性。我们还通过将数值GS解、代理预测和标准Shape Editor参考值联系起来，在EXL-50U托卡马克上建立了设备级验证，以评估仿真到设备的一致性。代理模型相对于GS解实现了$10^{-3}$-$10^{-2}$的误差，而GS到设备的差异保持在$10^{-3}$。Transformer在IID准确性上表现最佳，而CNN在准确性、鲁棒性和速度之间提供了最佳平衡，达到了0.7毫秒的TensorRT延迟。在未见过的等离子体几何形状和参数范围内，CNN和FNO表现出最强的外推稳定性，相对$L_2$误差为4%-5%，而归纳偏置较弱的模型性能下降更为显著。扩展数据和模型容量可以改善插值，但不一定能改善外推，这揭示了容量与OOD泛化之间的权衡。总体而言，这项工作为基于AI的GS预测提供了一个系统性的、设备一致的基准，并为实时等离子体控制和聚变应用中选择可靠代理模型提供了实用指导。

papers.title: Beyond Verdicts: A Graph-Based Analysis of Human and LLM Reasoning in Scientific Fact-Checking
papers.abstract: Misinformation that cites legitimate papers can be especially harmful when it distorts what those studies actually report. While existing automatic fact-checking systems based on large language models (LLMs) can assess whether a model assigns an Incorrect verdict and can gen- erate explanations for that decision, they typi- cally do not indicate whether the model follows the same reasoning path as human experts or arrives at the verdict through a different but still valid path. In this work, we introduce a graph- based framework (typed reasoning graph) for comparing human and LLM reasoning paths in scientific fact-checking. Building on prior work on fallacious reasoning in biomedical misinformation, MISSCIPLUS (Glockner et al., 2025), we model each explanation as a rea- soning graph that links the false claim to the relevant study context, study findings, fallacy- supporting premises, and fallacy labels. This representation enables one-to-one alignment of human and LLM reasoning at the level of fallacy-specific sub-graphs. For non-human- aligned LLM paths, we validate grounding in the cited study, relevance to the claim, and suf- ficiency for the verdict. Using 84 false claims from MISSCIPLUS, we evaluate GPT-5, Claude Opus 4.7, and Qwen3-32B across prompt and evidence settings. Results show distinct perfor- mance dimensions: Qwen3-32B has the lowest verdict failure rate, GPT-5 the highest human alignment, and Claude Opus 4.7 weak verdict prediction but often valid reasoning in success- ful cases

papers.title_zh: 超越判定：科学事实核查中人类与LLM推理的基于图的分析
papers.abstract_zh: 引用合法论文的错误信息在歪曲这些研究实际报告的内容时可能尤其有害。虽然现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动事实核查系统能够评估模型是否给出“不正确”判定，并能为此决定生成解释，但它们通常不能表明模型是否遵循与人类专家相同的推理路径，还是通过另一条不同但同样有效的路径得出判定。在这项工作中，我们引入了一个基于图的框架（类型化推理图），用于比较科学事实核查中人类与LLM的推理路径。基于先前关于生物医学错误信息中谬误推理的工作MISSCIPLUS（Glockner et al., 2025），我们将每个解释建模为一个推理图，该图将虚假声明与相关研究背景、研究发现、支持谬误的前提以及谬误标签连接起来。这种表示使得人类与LLM推理在特定谬误子图层面能够进行一一对齐。对于与人类不对齐的LLM路径，我们验证其是否依据引用的研究、是否与声明相关、以及是否足以支撑判定。利用MISSCIPLUS中的84个虚假声明，我们在不同提示词和证据设置下评估了GPT-5、Claude Opus 4.7和Qwen3-32B。结果显示不同的性能维度：Qwen3-32B的判定失败率最低，GPT-5的人类对齐度最高，而Claude Opus 4.7的判定预测较弱，但在成功案例中其推理往往有效。

papers.title: From Inertia to Objectivity: Improving Deep Research Agents with Noise Isolation
papers.abstract: Web search agents powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) show strong promise, but deep research tasks expose a recurring failure mode: once an agent has produced a query, plan, or intermediate conclusion, it becomes less objective when later judging the consequences of that same action. We term this phenomenon \textbf{inertia bias}. To make it measurable, we introduce the IBIS benchmark, which controls the search observations while varying whether the model is evaluating the outcome of its own prior action. We find that models are substantially worse when they ``own'' the preceding search step, showing that self-authored action history can systematically distort subsequent judgment. We further show that this bias propagates into two forms of system-level degradation: search noise at the worker level and contextual noise at the manager level. To address this problem, we propose NIS-Agent, which applies context isolation at the two decision points most vulnerable to inertia bias: webpage triage and final-answer validation. Across GAIA, WebWalkerQA, BrowseComp, and BrowseComp-zh, NIS-Agent achieves competitive performance while reducing token cost by 33\% compared to our baseline. We further train an 8B model to be intrinsically more resistant to inertia bias; under the same NIS-Agent framework, it attains average performance comparable to GPT-4o on deep research benchmarks.

papers.title_zh: 从惯性到客观性：通过噪声隔离改进深度研究智能体
papers.abstract_zh: 由大型语言模型（LLMs）驱动的网络搜索智能体显示出强大的潜力，但深度研究任务暴露出一种反复出现的失败模式：一旦智能体生成了查询、计划或中间结论，它在之后判断同一行动的结果时就会变得不够客观。我们将这种现象称为惯性偏差。为了使其可测量，我们引入了IBIS基准，该基准控制搜索观察结果，同时变化模型是否在评估其自身先前行动的结果。我们发现，当模型“拥有”先前的搜索步骤时，其表现会明显更差，这表明自我生成的行动历史会系统性地扭曲后续判断。我们进一步表明，这种偏差会传播为两种系统层面的退化：工作者层面的搜索噪声和管理者层面的上下文噪声。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了NIS-Agent，它在最易受惯性偏差影响的两个决策点应用上下文隔离：网页分诊和最终答案验证。在GAIA、WebWalkerQA、BrowseComp和BrowseComp-zh上，NIS-Agent实现了有竞争力的性能，同时与我们的基线相比将token成本降低了33%。我们进一步训练了一个8B模型，使其本质上更能抵抗惯性偏差；在相同的NIS-Agent框架下，它在深度研究基准上达到了与GPT-4o相当的平均性能。

papers.title: Channel-Token Attention for Reliable Dynamic Spectrum Access under Bursty Primary-User Traffic
papers.abstract: Dynamic spectrum access must coordinate secondary users under bursty primary-user activity while preserving packet reliability and delay. We present TACAN, a centralized policy that represents each channel as a token containing occupancy history and automatic-modulation-classification entropy; a context token supplies queue class, delay and user identity. A Transformer encoder is warm-started from an occupancy-greedy policy and refined with proximal policy optimization. The frozen policies were trained to maintain a channel assignment in every slot, including when queues were empty. We therefore replay them on held-out trajectories and distinguish standby assignment success from packet-present access and packet delivery. In a 20-channel network with 60 primary devices and 4 secondary users, TACAN achieves 92.53% +/- 0.47 packet-present access success, compared with 89.94% for Greedy and 83.53% for PPO+MLP. Its paired gain over Greedy is 2.59 points (parametric 95% CI 1.89-3.29), with wins in all five seeds; the exact two-sided sign-test value is 0.0625. The gain rises from 0.57 points at normal primary-user load to 7.67 points at extreme load. TACAN also reduces mean delivery delay from 1.208 to 1.123 slots and the conditional user-reliability gap from 9.69 to 3.15 points. Delivered packets per SU-slot remain arrival-limited (30.12% versus 30.11%), so no packet-throughput gain is claimed.

papers.title_zh: 突发主用户流量下可靠动态频谱接入的信道-令牌注意力
papers.abstract_zh: 动态频谱接入必须在突发的主用户活动下协调次用户，同时保持数据包可靠性和延迟。我们提出了TACAN，一种集中式策略，将每个信道表示为一个令牌，包含占用历史记录和自动调制分类熵；一个上下文令牌提供队列类别、延迟和用户身份。一个Transformer编码器从占用贪婪策略热启动，并通过近端策略优化进行细化。冻结的策略被训练为在每个时隙中维持信道分配，包括队列为空时。因此，我们在留出轨迹上重放它们，并区分待机分配成功与存在数据包时的接入和数据包投递。在一个有60个主设备和4个次用户的20信道网络中，TACAN实现了92.53% +/- 0.47的数据包存在接入成功率，而Greedy为89.94%，PPO+MLP为83.53%。其相对于Greedy的配对增益为2.59个点（参数95% CI 1.89-3.29），在所有五个种子中均获胜；精确双侧符号检验值为0.0625。该增益从正常主用户负载下的0.57个点上升到极端负载下的7.67个点。TACAN还将平均投递延迟从1.208个时隙降低到1.123个时隙，并将条件用户可靠性差距从9.69个点降低到3.15个点。每个SU时隙的投递数据包仍受到达限制（30.12%对30.11%），因此不声称数据包吞吐量增益。

papers.title: Exploring Dowker Homology for Sentence Similarity
papers.abstract: Dowker homology is a topological tool that may be used to analyze the relative position of two point clouds living in a common space. We investigate whether Dowker homology captures sentence similarity information by treating the embeddings of the tokens that constitute a sentence pair as a pair of point clouds in the latent space of a transformer model, using both models that have and have not been fine-tuned for sentence similarity. We find that Dowker homology captures sentence similarity information, as measured by regressing Dowker homology features onto ground-truth similarity scores, and that it can be used for visual inspection of similarity data and models. In an attempt to make Dowker homology readily applicable, we derive from it single-number summaries that we expect to capture sentence similarity directly. These turn out to work reasonably well, but without outperforming standard sentence similarity measures based on established pooling methods.

papers.title_zh: 探索Dowker同调在句子相似性中的应用
papers.abstract_zh: Dowker同调是一种拓扑工具，可用于分析位于同一空间中两个点云的相对位置。我们通过将构成句子对的令牌嵌入视为Transformer模型潜在空间中的一对点云，使用已经针对句子相似性进行微调和未进行微调的模型，研究Dowker同调是否能够捕获句子相似性信息。我们发现，通过将Dowker同调特征回归到真实相似性得分来度量，Dowker同调能够捕获句子相似性信息，并且可用于相似性数据和模型的视觉检查。为了使Dowker同调易于应用，我们从中推导出单一数值摘要，期望其能直接捕获句子相似性。这些摘要表现尚可，但并未超越基于既有池化方法的标准句子相似性度量。

papers.title: AraDetox: A Multi-Dialect Arabic Detoxification Dataset
papers.abstract: Arabic harmful-language detection has received considerable attention, yet Arabic text detoxification remains underexplored. We introduce AraDetox, a multi-dialect Arabic detoxification dataset comprising 10,500 harmful social-media posts and 84,000 detoxified rewrites generated using GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Flash across Modern Standard Arabic, Gulf, Levantine, and Egyptian Arabic. The generated outputs were assessed through human evaluation and automatic analyses of lexical change, semantic preservation, sentiment, and dialectal style. Results show that detoxification is primarily a meaning-preserving rewriting task: substantial lexical and structural reformulation is accompanied by consistently high semantic similarity. Human evaluation confirms successful harmful-language removal while largely preserving the original meaning. Dialectal analyses further indicate that the generated variants exhibit measurable stylistic alignment with reference Arabic dialect corpora. Comparison with existing resources highlights two complementary approaches to detoxification: minimal-edit lexical substitution and meaning-preserving reformulation. Our findings demonstrate that large-scale Arabic detoxification resources can be constructed through LLM-assisted generation and human verification. The dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/ArabicNLP-UK/AraDetox to support future research on Arabic detoxification, safe text generation, and multi-dialect Arabic NLP.

papers.title_zh: AraDetox：一个多方言阿拉伯语去毒化数据集
papers.abstract_zh: 阿拉伯语有害语言检测已受到相当多的关注，但阿拉伯语文本去毒化仍未得到充分探索。我们引入了AraDetox，一个多方言阿拉伯语去毒化数据集，包含10,500条有害社交媒体帖文和84,000条去毒化改写，这些改写由GPT-5和Gemini 2.5 Flash在現代标准阿拉伯语、海湾阿拉伯语、黎凡特阿拉伯语和埃及阿拉伯语上生成。生成的输出通过人工评估以及词汇变化、语义保持、情感和方言风格方面的自动分析进行了评估。结果表明，去毒化主要是一项保持语义的改写任务：大量的词汇和结构重构伴随着持续较高的语义相似度。人工评估证实了有害语言的成功移除，同时在很大程度上保留了原始含义。方言分析进一步表明，生成的变体与参考阿拉伯语方言语料库表现出可测量的风格一致性。与现有资源的比较突出了两种互补的去毒化方法：最小编辑词汇替换和保持语义的重构。我们的研究结果表明，通过LLM辅助生成和人工验证，可以构建大规模阿拉伯语去毒化资源。该数据集公开发布于https://github.com/ArabicNLP-UK/AraDetox，以支持未来在阿拉伯语去毒化、安全文本生成和多方言阿拉伯语NLP方面的研究。

papers.title: CatchBench: When Can an Agent Failure Be Caught?
papers.abstract: When can an agent failure be caught? An audit is usually limited by the record rather than by the method. CatchBench therefore puts one auditor's question to three information states: the declared configuration before a run (PRE), a growing prefix of its trace (LIVE), and the finished trace (POST). Prior benchmarks fix one of these states or vary the telemetry; to our knowledge none scores all three under one task-method interface. Each state admits different questions, so seven task contracts carry their own labels and metrics rather than one leaderboard. Four are evidential; three are Gold-derived mechanism diagnostics. The release scores 72 entrants, from rule scanners and structural models to eleven LLM judges across nine model families (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Gemma, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, Nova), over 1187 declared configurations and 1162 recorded runs. Most of the arena does not order: 47 of 118 pre-declared contrasts separate, and the rest are published unresolved rather than ranked. The two sharpest results cut against our own data. One rule ignores every name and permission; it flags each capability declared after the first. On one of six configuration sources it reaches a perfect F1, so a score there measures how the corpus was built rather than how well a method reasons. Our admissibility bar then rejected one injected substrate and withheld evidential status from the other. A benchmark number is therefore not interpretable until the process behind its labels is published and tested for the shortcut it may leave. We report both, and regenerate every ordering from released predictions with no model call.

papers.title_zh: CatchBench：智能体故障何时能被捕获？
papers.abstract_zh: 何时能捕获智能体故障？审计通常受限于记录而非方法。因此，CatchBench将一个审计员的问题置于三种信息状态下：运行前声明的配置（PRE）、轨迹不断增长的前缀（LIVE）以及完整的轨迹（POST）。先前的基准测试固定其中一种状态或改变遥测方式；据我们所知，没有任何基准在同一任务-方法接口下对这三种状态进行评分。每种状态都允许不同的问题，因此七个任务契约拥有各自的标签和指标，而非一个排行榜。四个是证据性的；三个是源自Gold的机制诊断。该发布对72个参赛者进行评分，从规则扫描器和结构模型到九个模型家族（GPT、Claude、Gemini、Gemma、Llama、Qwen、DeepSeek、Mistral、Nova）的十一个LLM评判器，涵盖1187个声明的配置和1162次记录的运行。竞技场的大部分不排序：118个预先声明的对比中有47个分离，其余以未解决而非排名的方式发布。两个最尖锐的结果与我们的自身数据相悖。一条规则忽略所有名称和权限；它标记第一个之后声明的每个能力。在六个配置来源之一上，它达到了完美的F1，因此那里的分数衡量的是语料库的构建方式，而非方法推理的好坏。我们的可接受性门槛随后拒绝了一个注入的底层数据，并扣留了另一个的证据地位。因此，在标签背后的过程被公开并测试其可能留下的捷径之前，基准数字是不可解释的。我们报告了这两者，并从已发布的预测中重新生成每个排序，无需调用模型。

papers.title: A Practical Optimization for Wiedemann XL
papers.abstract: Wiedemann XL is a variant of the XL algorithm that has been widely used in algebraic attacks. Usually, the cost of applying Widemann XL is estimated as 3N^2 ω, where N is the width of the Macaulay matrix, and ω is the average row weight of the Macaulay matrix. Among 3N^2 ω, 2N^2 ω is from the 1st phase of the algorithm, while N^2 ω is from the 3rd phase of the algorithm. This paper shows a practical optimization that reduces the cost of the 3rd phase by a huge factor so that its cost becomes essentially negligible compared to that of the 1st phase. Our optimization makes use of the fact that to obtain a solution of the multivariate system, only a small part of the kernel vectors is needed.

papers.title: TRACE: A Self-Evolving Skill Bank for Consistent, Limit-Aware LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Reliable deployment of LLM agents in user-facing products depends not on raw task-solving ability but on consistency and limit-awareness: behaving the same way across repeated trials, and recognizing when a request cannot, or cannot yet, be safely fulfilled. CAR-bench exposes this reliability gap in the domain of in-car assistants: an LLM-simulated user issues incomplete or ambiguous requests, requiring the agent to resolve uncertainty through multi-turn dialogue and tool use while strictly adhering to domain policies. Even frontier models show a substantial gap between what they can solve at least once (Pass@3) and what they solve consistently across trials (Pass^k). We bridge this gap with TRACE (TRAjectory-Contrastive Evolution), which iteratively improves a skill-based agent's behavioral knowledge without modifying model weights. This knowledge is organized as a Skill Bank of modular, retrievable skills, each encoding a self-contained set of tool-use rules and behavioral guidelines. TRACE evolves this bank through an agentic self-evolution loop: after each evaluation round, it groups trajectories by the skills invoked and refines each skill by contrasting successful and failed behaviors. The updated bank then guides subsequent rounds, while during deployment the Actor performs state-conditioned skill orchestration at every turn. On GPT-5.5, TRACE improves consistency (Pass^3) by 34.6 points, from 59.9% to 94.5%, while shrinking the gap between potential and reliable performance to just 4.0 points. On the official hidden set, TRACE achieved first place using GPT-5.6-Sol, attaining a Pass^3 score of 70%-a 40% relative improvement over the baseline. These results show that TRACE converts high model potential into stable, consistent performance gain. Project homepage: https://darwin-agent.github.io/Car-bench-TRACE.

papers.title_zh: TRACE：用于一致且具有限制意识的LLM智能体的自我进化技能库
papers.abstract_zh: 在面向用户的产品中可靠部署LLM智能体，并不取决于原始的任务解决能力，而是取决于一致性和限制意识：在重复试验中表现相同，并识别出某个请求何时无法、或暂时无法被安全地满足。CAR-bench 在车载助手领域揭示了这一可靠性差距：一个由LLM模拟的用户会发出不完整或含糊的请求，要求智能体通过多轮对话和工具使用来解决不确定性，同时严格遵守领域策略。即使是前沿模型，在其至少能解决一次的内容（Pass@3）与跨试验一致解决的内容（Pass^k）之间也显示出巨大差距。我们用 TRACE（TRAjectory-Contrastive Evolution，轨迹对比进化）弥合了这一差距，它在不修改模型权重的情况下，迭代式地改进基于技能的智能体的行为知识。这些知识被组织为一个技能库（Skill Bank），其中包含模块化、可检索的技能，每项技能都编码了一套自包含的工具使用规则和行为准则。TRACE 通过一个智能体自我进化循环来进化这个技能库：在每一轮评估之后，它根据所调用的技能对轨迹进行分组，并通过对比成功和失败的行为来细化每项技能。更新后的技能库随后指导后续轮次，而在部署期间，Actor 会在每一步执行基于状态的技能编排。在 GPT-5.5 上，TRACE 将一致性（Pass^3）提升了34.6个百分点，从59.9%提高到94.5%，同时将潜在性能与可靠性能之间的差距缩小到仅4.0个百分点。在官方隐藏集上，TRACE 使用 GPT-5.6-Sol 取得了第一名，Pass^3 得分达到70%——相比基线相对提升了40%。这些结果表明，TRACE 能将高的模型潜力转化为稳定、一致的性能提升。项目主页：https://darwin-agent.github.io/Car-bench-TRACE。

papers.title: XTC: Head-Aware Sampling by Excluding Top Choices
papers.abstract: Standard decoding rules for autoregressive language models promote diversity by rescaling the full next-token distribution or truncating its low-probability tail. These strategies overlook a common regime of open-ended generation in which several continuations are plausible but too much probability mass remains concentrated on the most generic choice. We introduce XTC (Exclude Top Choices), a lightweight head-aware decoding operator that targets this regime directly. XTC identifies tokens whose probabilities exceed an absolute plausibility threshold $τ$: when at least two qualify, it removes the dominant eligible choices with probability $ρ$ and retains only the weakest plausible alternative before renormalization. Across 60 experiments on Gemma 3 27B Q4, Gemma 3 12B Q6, and DeepSeek R1 14B Q6, with scaling validation on Llama 3.3 70B Q4, XTC improves the diversity-repetition Pareto frontier. On creative generation, Distinct-2 increases by 11--15% and repeat trigrams decrease by 27--47% across the four models. Combined with temperature scaling, gains reach 38% in Distinct-2 and 71% in repeat-trigram reduction over baseline. A blinded Amazon Mechanical Turk study with 150 Master raters yields a 62.3% creativity preference for XTC ($p<10^{-4}$) without reduced fluency, while a GPT-4o control judge reproduces the Anthropic-judge direction on every measure. On IFEval with Llama 3.3 70B Q4, XTC preserves prompt-level strict accuracy within 1.7 percentage points of baseline while recovering most of the diversity gain; a temperature setting matched on Distinct-2 reduces IFEval by 8.8 points. The effect is additive with temperature and repetition penalties, robust across quantization levels and model families, and consistent across twelve prompt genres. XTC has been adopted by llama.cpp, ExLlamaV2, and text-generation-webui.

papers.title_zh: XTC：通过排除最高选择实现头部感知采样
papers.abstract_zh: 自回归语言模型的标准解码规则通过重新缩放完整的下一个词元分布或截断其低概率尾部来促进多样性。这些策略忽视了一种常见的开放式生成场景：多种续写都合理，但过多的概率质量仍集中在最通用的选择上。我们引入了XTC（Exclude Top Choices），一种轻量级的头部感知解码算子，直接针对这一场景。XTC识别概率超过绝对合理性阈值τ的词元：当至少两个词元符合条件时，它以概率ρ移除占主导地位的合格选择，并在重新归一化之前仅保留最弱的合理备选词元。在Gemma 3 27B Q4、Gemma 3 12B Q6和DeepSeek R1 14B Q6上进行的60项实验中，以及在Llama 3.3 70B Q4上的规模验证中，XTC改善了多样性-重复帕累托前沿。在创意生成方面，四个模型的Distinct-2提高了11%–15%，重复三元组减少了27%–47%。与温度缩放相结合时，相较基线，Distinct-2的提升达到38%，重复三元组的减少达到71%。一项包含150名Master评分者的盲法Amazon Mechanical Turk研究显示，XTC获得了62.3%的创造力偏好（p<10⁻⁴），且流畅性未降低；而GPT-4o对照评判员在每项指标上都复现了Anthropic评判员的方向。在Llama 3.3 70B Q4上的IFEval中，XTC将提示级严格准确率保持在基线的1.7个百分点以内，同时恢复了大部分多样性收益；在Distinct-2上匹配的温度设置使IFEval降低了8.8个百分点。该效应与温度和重复惩罚具有加性，在不同量化级别和模型家族中均表现稳健，并在十二种提示类型中保持一致。XTC已被llama.cpp、ExLlamaV2和text-generation-webui采用。

papers.title: TEE-X: TEE-aware Acceleration Framework for Large Vision Models at the Edge
papers.abstract: Despite their remarkable success, machine learning models, particularly in vision applications, are alarmingly vulnerable to a range of security threats. One key factor in the attack landscape is the distinction between white-box and black-box threat models, as the latter poses challenges that limit attack effectiveness when access to model information is limited. As a result, using Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) enhances security for machine learning applications by protecting model confidentiality and execution integrity, effectively shifting the execution environment from the white-box to the black-box side of the threat model spectrum. While adopting TEEs for large vision models, e.g., Vision Transformers (ViTs), is crucial for enhancing security and privacy, significant challenges related to memory constraints and increased computational latency must be addressed, especially in time-sensitive edge applications where safety and privacy are paramount. The objective of this work is to enable large vision models to be fully hosted within TEEs, achieving GPU-level inference latency for time-sensitive edge vision applications while maintaining performance. To this end, we propose TEE-X, a TEE-aware acceleration framework that introduces a sensitivity-aware modularization technique and enables vectorization in TEE inference. This design is validated on OP-TEE for Arm TrustZone, configured to optimize performance on the NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier for efficient edge vision applications using ViT models. The findings reveal that TEE-X delivers an effective TEE-aware acceleration framework that achieves minimal accuracy-latency trade-offs while ensuring fast and secure edge inference for vision models.

papers.summary_zh:
# 全文精选：TEE-X (TEE-aware Acceleration Framework for Large Vision Models at the Edge)

## 核心结论

TEE-X 是面向边缘场景的 TEE 感知加速框架，核心主张是：将完整的大型视觉模型（如 DeiT-Small/Base）置于 Arm TrustZone/OP-TEE 可信执行环境内执行，通过“灵敏度感知模块化 + SIMD 向量化”消除 TEE 计算与内存瓶颈，使推理延迟逼近原生 GPU，同时保持高精度。作者声称其达到“近 GPU 延迟”并维持模型机密性；实验证据显示，在单 batch 场景下，DeiT-Small/CIFAR-10 中 TEE-X 延迟 1082.67ms（C=0.5）或 1006.74ms（C=0.4），与 Host GPU 的 1022.35ms 相当，模型体积压缩 23–47 倍而准确率下降不超过 2.65 个百分点。

## 问题与威胁模型

大型视觉模型易受内存故障注入、侧信道和对抗攻击。攻击者分白盒/黑盒两类：白盒攻击者完全掌握架构、权重与梯度，攻击难度低；黑盒攻击者仅能查询输入输出。TEE 的核心安全收益是将推理从白盒移向黑盒。TEE 部署大模型面临三重挑战：TEE 内存容量有限、计算开销/延迟高于 GPU、边缘时序敏感。威胁模型假设：TEE（Arm TrustZone carve-out）是可信飞地，TEE 内数据、参数、计算均安全；主机系统（含 GPU）不可信；侧信道攻击不在范围内。在 TEE 内调用 GPU 会暴露权重与中间数据，因此计算全部在 CPU 上完成。

## 方法与关键技术

TEE-X 的端到端流程可概括为：灵敏度评估 → 模块划分与预算分配 → 变换网络训练 → 安全部署与向量化执行。下面按逻辑顺序展开。

**1. 灵敏度感知模块划分。** 输入为预训练 ViT 权重 \(W=\{w_1,\dots,w_L\}\)。对第 \(i\) 层施加高斯扰动 \(g_i\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I)\)，令 \(\Delta w_i=\epsilon\|w_i\|_F \, g_i/\|g_i\|_F\)，仅替换第 \(i\) 层后测准确率变化，定义灵敏度 \(S_i=A_{w}-A_{ew_i}\)——该值越大说明该层越敏感。按灵敏度将 L 层聚为 K 个模块 \(G_k\)，灵敏度相近的层进入同一模块。实验中 K=3，各模块层数按 (L/3−1, L/3, L/3+1) 分配（即 3、4、5 层）。

**2. TEE 感知的计算预算分配。** 对每层 \(i\)，将权重 \(w_i\in\mathbb{R}^{n_i\times n_o}\) 分解为 \(w_i=A_i B_i\)（\(A_i\in\mathbb{R}^{n_i\times h_i}\)，\(B_i\in\mathbb{R}^{h_i\times n_o}\)），\(h_i\) 即该层在 TEE 中的“计算预算”。为使 TEE 延迟匹配 GPU，预算约束为 \(\sum n_{g_k} h_k \le C\)。理论推导中，GPU 推理时间近似为 \(2N n_i n_o T_{gpu}\)，由此得出每层预算 \(h_i=\frac{n_i n_o}{n_i+n_o}\cdot\frac{T_{gpu}}{T_{TEE}}\)，C 为各层 h_i 之和。由于精确解计算昂贵，作者改用灵敏度引导的启发式规则：\(h_k=(\sum_{j\in G_k}S_j/\sum_{i\in L}S_i)\cdot C/n_{g_k}\)；实验表明该分配优于均匀预算（Uniform Budget，C=0.2 时 94.64% vs 91.27%）。

**3. 变换网络训练。** 每个模块 \(G_k\) 训练两个变换：\(T_k\)（2 层线性 MLP，带 pre/post affine，实现 \(w_i\to A_i\)）和 \(B_k\)（单线性层，实现 \(A_i\to w_i\)），使得 \(w_i\approx A_i B_i\)。训练损失为交叉熵 \(L_{CE}\)、蒸馏损失 \(L_{KD}=\tau^2\,\mathrm{KL}(\sigma(F(x)/\tau)\,\|\,\sigma(\hat{F}(x)/\tau))\) 与逐层输出 MSE \(L_{MSE}\) 的加权和。推理阶段只保留 \(A_k=T_k(w_k)\) 与 \(B_k\)，原权重全部丢弃。实验中对 attn_qkv、attn_proj、mlp_fc1、mlp_fc2 做分解，跳过首尾层和 LayerNorm；\(T_k\) 采用 4-bit QAT，首尾层保留 8-bit。这一步骤的端到端效果是：大权重矩阵被替换为两个低秩小矩阵，使全模型可驻留于 TEE 受限内存。

**4. 向量化执行与内存管理。** 利用 Arm Neon SIMD：128 位寄存器并行处理 4 个 float32，使用 `vdupq_n_f32` 广播、`vld1q_f32` 载入、`vfmaq_f32` 乘加，内循环展开至 4 个累加寄存器；OP-TEE 需开启 `CFG_WITH_VFP`。权重经共享内存 `TEEC_RegisterSharedMemory` 传入，中间张量留在安全内存并及时释放。向量化与模块化相互配合：模块化缩小了需驻留内存的权重集，向量化则弥补了 CPU 相比 GPU 的算术吞吐差距。正文未提及任何密码学原语（如加密、签名或不可分辨混淆）。

**5. 端到端衔接。** 部署时整个模型均在 TEE 内执行，输入 \(x_i\)、权重、中间激活均不出可信边界；主机仅能看到不可信的输入输出查询，从而将攻击面从白盒降为黑盒。离线训练变换网络、在线仅执行分解后矩阵乘法，形成清晰“离线压缩—在线安全推理”的划分。

## 安全性

TEE-X 的安全论证是结构性的：整个模型（包括权重和中间张量）留在可信内存中，避免了模型分区或运算拆分方案中“出 TEE 暴露层信息”的缺陷；主机和 GPU 即使被攻陷也无法读取权重。实验观察支持“白盒→黑盒”的转化：DeiT-B 的白盒对抗攻击成功率为 99.40%，黑盒仅 60.00%；白盒比特翻转攻击成功率达 100.0%，黑盒为 0.0%。作者未承诺抵御侧信道攻击（如缓存时序、Rowhammer、Foreshadow 类攻击），正文明确将侧信道排除在威胁模型之外。

## 实验与性能

实验平台为 Jetson AGX Xavier（8 核 Armv8.2 2.2GHz，Volta GPU），固定 CPU 频率并使用单核；TEE 为 Arm TrustZone/OP-TEE；模型为 DeiT-Small/Base，数据集为 CIFAR-10 与 ImageNet。

- **延迟对比（DeiT-Small，CIFAR-10）**：Naive 全模型入 TEE 1792.42ms、模型分割 1463.80ms、运算拆分 3127.73ms，TEE-X 仅 1082.67ms，逼近 Host GPU 的 1022.35ms。

- **消融**：去掉模块化（w/o modularization）准确率同 Naive 97.29% 但时间 1.80s，比 TEE-X 慢 80%；去掉向量化（w/o vectorization）时间 1.77s，慢 77%；完整 TEE-X 为 1.08s，与 Host GPU 的 1.02s 基本持平。

## 局限与阅读判断

**正文明确指出的局限**：①仅单 batch 场景可与 GPU 匹配；当 batch>1 时 GPU 并行优势增大，TEE-X 性能差距扩大。②精确预算求解被灵敏度启发式替代，无法保证全局最优。③侧信道攻击不在范围内，对物理

papers.abstract_guide_zh:
**一句话结论**：TEE-X 是一个面向边缘大视觉模型的 TEE 感知（TEE-aware）加速框架，通过敏感度感知模块化和 TEE 推理向量化，在可信执行环境中实现接近 GPU 级的快速安全推理。

**问题与动机**：机器学习模型尤其在视觉应用中面临多种安全威胁。攻击威胁模型分为白盒（white-box，攻击者掌握模型信息）与黑盒（black-box，攻击者仅能查询）两类。使用可信执行环境（TEE, Trusted Execution Environment）可以保护模型机密性与执行完整性，将执行环境从白盒一侧推向黑盒一侧，从而增强安全性。但将大型视觉模型（如 Vision Transformer, ViT，视觉 Transformer）完全放入 TEE 时，内存限制和计算延迟增加成为瓶颈，尤其对时间敏感的边缘应用影响较大。

**方法与技术路线**：该框架的设定是让大视觉模型完全驻留于 TEE 内，并以 GPU 级推理延迟为目标。TEE-X 包含两个关键模块：其一，敏感度感知模块化（sensitivity-aware modularization）——将模型按敏感度划分为不同模块，用于在 TEE 内合理化模型组织并缓解内存压力；其二，TEE 推理向量化（vectorization）——在 TEE 推理过程中启用向量化计算，以降低延迟。摘要未说明模块化的具体划分规则、向量化的实现方式，也未披露输入数据、参数设置及实验数据集。验证环境为 OP-TEE（Arm TrustZone 的可信执行环境实现），目标硬件是 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier，使用 ViT 模型进行边缘推理优化；摘要同样未说明对比基线和具体精度/延迟数值。

**主要结果**：摘要报告 TEE-X 提供了有效的 TEE 感知加速框架，实现了快速且安全的边缘推理，并具有最小的精度-延迟权衡。但未给出量化结果。

**为什么与兴趣相关**：这项工作将 TEE 与模型加速结合，直接面向视觉模型推理的机密性与完整性保护，同时关注边缘场景下的实时性能。对在不可信或受限硬件上部署大视觉模型的研究与工程实践具有参考价值。

papers.title: Bit Operation Cost of ``Holdout'' Key-Recovery Attacks Against Classic McEliece
papers.abstract: We present a self-contained conditional arithmetic model and algorithmic specification for a prospective key-recovery attack on binary Goppa codes, combining the binary hold-out operator with heterogeneous Hasse multiplicities, Lucas-minimal derivative levels, augmented binary block Wiedemann, and reconstruction from local flags. The first two reductions give exact, dimension-guaranteed attack-parameter configurations for every Classic McEliece parameter set. We derive the sparse operator, safe-rank-bound sequence state, a relation-generation tally assuming one attempt per relation batch, higher-flag arithmetic, and the downstream solve performed for every guess. At the selected configurations, modeled affine normalization with dense solves ranges from $2^{172.13}$ to $2^{235.09}$ gates, while projective normalization with nested solves ranges from $2^{146.29}$ to $2^{207.83}$. For mceliece348864, a configuration with $c=7$ gives $2^{142.15}$ modeled gates and retains $2^{61.7}$ bits, excluding temporary solver memory. An exhaustive scan of 19,338 admitted singleton (one-position hold-out) configurations finds a $2^{114.35}$ relation-generation floor in the same fixed model; no downstream-only improvement can cross it. A synthetic experiment heuristically supports the Frobenius-phase balance test, but no public pure cross-pairing is known. None of the tallies is an established break: reliable small-field Krylov yield, higher-flag recovery from the priced truncated block, binary reconstruction, cross-anchor independence, and memory-aware implementation remain open. This manuscript is currently a living tracking document.

papers.title: GET: Generative Embedding Translation for Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract: Generative segmentation provides an alternative to direct pixel-wise prediction by operating on learned latent representations, but effective image-to-mask translation must preserve target structure while remaining computationally efficient. We propose Generative Embedding Translation (GET), a structured embedding-translation framework that progressively transforms image embeddings into mask embeddings within the frozen latent space of a Stable Diffusion VAE. GET uses a U-Net-style Embedding Translation Network with 1.07M trainable parameters, combining Mobile Bottleneck Convolutions, Subsampled Self-Attention, and Multi-scale Feature Enrichment for local modeling, global context, and multi-scale refinement. Across five medical segmentation datasets, GET outperforms generative, CNN, and Transformer baselines. Compared with the strongest generative baseline, GMS, GET improves average Dice and IoU by 0.93% and 1.26%, reduces HD95 by 0.81 pixels, and uses 31.41% fewer trainable parameters. Under bidirectional BUS-BUSI domain shift, GET further improves Dice and IoU by 3.51% and 3.39%, while reducing HD95 by 27.37 pixels. Our code is available at: https://github.com/maklachur/GET.

papers.abstract_zh: 生成式分割通过对学习到的潜在表示进行操作，为直接像素级预测提供了一种替代方案，但有效的图像到掩膜转换必须在保持目标结构的同时，仍具有计算效率。我们提出了生成式嵌入转换（GET），这是一种结构化的嵌入转换框架，在Stable Diffusion VAE的冻结潜在空间内，逐步将图像嵌入转换为掩膜嵌入。GET使用了一个U-Net风格的嵌入转换网络，具有1.07M个可训练参数，结合了Mobile瓶颈卷积、子采样自注意力和多尺度特征增强，用于局部建模、全局上下文和多尺度细化。在五个医学分割数据集上，GET优于生成式、CNN和Transformer基线模型。与最强的生成式基线GMS相比，GET的平均Dice和IoU分别提高了0.93%和1.26%，HD95降低了0.81像素，并且使用的可训练参数减少了31.41%。在双向BUS-BUSI域偏移下，GET进一步将Dice和IoU分别提高了3.51%和3.39%，同时将HD95降低了27.37像素。我们的代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/maklachur/GET.

papers.title: What AstroPT knows about galaxies, and what that can teach us about LLMs
papers.abstract: Interpretability research increasingly asks when concepts emerge during training and whether linear probes recover real structure, but in language models these claims are hard to validate because language offers little ground-truth ordering of concepts or relationships among them. We propose the use of astronomical ground truth through AstroPT, a transformer trained on millions of galaxy images, as a calibration testbed. AstroPT is an LLM-like model trained within a domain where the difficulty ordering of concepts and the relations among them are known in advance. Probing frozen representations across checkpoints, layers, model sizes, and objective choices, we find that galaxy properties emerge in a fixed order that tracks their known difficulty---quantities written almost directly into the pixels (band magnitude) become decodable early in training and shallow in the network, while multiband/spectra based and inferred quantities (such as redshift and specific star formation rate) emerge later and deeper. This order is invariant to our tested training objectives, and scales in magnitude but not in sequence with capacity. Our linear probe directions further recover the known physical structure among galaxy properties. Our findings suggest that astronomy offers a controlled sandbox for calibrating mechanistic interpretability methods we otherwise apply to LLMs blind.

papers.title_zh: AstroPT 对星系的了解，以及这能教给我们关于 LLM 的什么
papers.abstract_zh: 可解释性研究日益关注概念在训练过程中何时出现，以及线性探针是否恢复了真实结构，但在语言模型中，这些主张很难验证，因为语言很少为概念提供基准排序，也很少为概念之间的关系提供基准。我们提议通过 AstroPT（一个在数百万星系图像上训练的 transformer）使用天文学基准，作为校准测试平台。AstroPT 是一个类似 LLM 的模型，其训练领域内概念间的难度排序及它们之间的关系是预先已知的。跨检查点、层、模型规模和目标选择探测冻结表示，我们发现星系属性以固定顺序出现，该顺序遵循其已知难度——几乎直接写入像素的量（波段星等）在训练早期和网络浅层即可解码，而基于多波段/光谱的量和推断量（如红移和比恒星形成率）则更晚、在更深层出现。这个顺序对我们测试的训练目标保持不变，并且随容量在幅度上扩展、而顺序不变。我们的线性探针方向进一步恢复了星系属性间已知的物理结构。我们的发现表明，天文学为校准我们否则会盲目应用于 LLM 的机制可解释性方法提供了一个受控沙盒。

papers.title: Vision-Language Models for Occupational Physical Exposure Assessment: Estimating External Hand Forces in Manual Material Handling Tasks from RGB Video
papers.abstract: External hand forces are important inputs to biomechanical analyses of occupational physical exposure and injury risk, yet continuous force measurements during manual material handling (MMH) typically requires instrumented objects or specialized sensing. We evaluated a vision-language model (VLM)-based pipeline that combines task-specific textual cues, visual representations, and known box mass to estimate dynamic, triaxial, bilateral external hand forces from RGB video. Thirty-five healthy young adults performed five MMH tasks involving lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling with box masses of 6, 9, and 12 kg. The pipeline used text-guided localization of participant and handled-object regions of interest (ROIs), pretrained vision-transformer feature extraction, and transformer-based temporal regression. Performance was evaluated using leave-one-subject-out validation across seven camera-view conditions (three single-view and four multi-view conditions) and four ROI strategies. Overall, root mean square error was ~4.7-5.6 N for the horizontal and mediolateral force components and ~10.6-11.0 N for the vertical component. Including the handled object as a second ROI generally improved force estimation, with some of the largest benefits under single-camera conditions, whereas pixel-level segmentation provided little additional improvement. Multi-camera capture provided the clearest benefit for peak-force estimation, particularly for the vertical component, whereas differences in overall frame-level error among camera configurations were comparatively modest. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of estimating continuous, bilateral, directional hand-force estimates from RGB video and known load mass without requiring sensors on the worker or handled objects as model inputs, supporting the development of more scalable occupational physical exposure and risk assessments.

papers.title_zh: 用于职业体力暴露评估的视觉-语言模型：从RGB视频估计人工物料搬运任务中的外部手部受力
papers.abstract_zh: 外部手部受力是职业体力暴露与损伤风险的生物力学分析的重要输入，然而在人工物料搬运（MMH）过程中进行连续力测量通常需要仪器化物体或专用传感设备。我们评估了一种基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的流程，该流程结合了任务特定的文本线索、视觉表示和已知箱子质量，从RGB视频估计动态、三轴、双侧的外部手部受力。三十五名健康年轻成年人执行了五项MMH任务，涉及提举、搬运、推和拉，箱子质量为6、9和12 kg。该流程使用文本引导的参与者与操作物体感兴趣区域（ROI）定位、预训练的视觉变换器特征提取以及基于变换器的时间回归。性能通过留一受试者交叉验证进行评估，涵盖七种相机视角条件（三种单视角和四种多视角条件）和四种ROI策略。总体而言，水平分量和内外侧力分量的均方根误差约为4.7-5.6 N，垂直分量约为10.6-11.0 N。将操作物体作为第二个ROI纳入通常改善了力估计，在单相机条件下获益最大，而像素级分割带来的额外改进很小。多相机采集对峰值力估计的益处最为明显，尤其是对垂直分量，而相机配置之间整体帧级误差的差异相对较小。这些发现证明了在无需将工人或操作物体上的传感器作为模型输入的情况下，从RGB视频和已知负载质量估计连续、双侧、方向性手部受力的可行性，支持开发更具可扩展性的职业体力暴露与风险评估方法。

papers.title: The Power of Rerandomization in Obfustopia: Collision-Resistant Hash, Somewhere-Extractable BARGs, and More
papers.abstract: Indistinguishability obfuscation (iO) combined with one-way functions (OWFs) serves as a powerful foundation for constructing a vast array of cryptographic primitives. However, this combination faces a known black-box barrier established by Asharov and Segev (FOCS '15), which proves the impossibility of constructing collision-resistant hash (CRH) functions. The Asharov-Segev barrier naturally extends to stronger primitives that imply CRH, such as fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) and somewhere-extractable non-interactive batch arguments (seBARGs). This work investigates the power of iO and rerandomizable primitives in constructing such "CRH-hard" primitives. First, we demonstrate the first direct and simple approach to building CRH from iO and rerandomizable OWFs. The only previously known construction was due to Arnon, Ben-David and Yogev (CRYPTO '25), and needed to go through the construction of the adaptively sound SNARG of Waters and Wu (STOC 24'). Using the same approach, we additionally construct a strictly stronger primitive than CRH, which we call perfectly partitionable hash (PPH), from iO and rerandomizable commitments. Second, we demonstrate the power of rerandomizability for building advanced non-interactive proof systems. Using iO and rerandomizable commitments, we provide a construction of seBARGs with statistical extraction, a security property not achieved by most existing seBARG schemes. By additionally relying on rate-1 fully-homomorphic encryption, we construct the first rate-1 seBARG with statistical extraction. Along the way, we introduce a SNARG that is "sometimes statistically sound", and construct it from iO and rerandomizable commitments.

papers.title_zh: 重随机化在Obfustopia中的力量：碰撞抵抗哈希、某处可提取BARG及更多
papers.abstract_zh: 不可区分性混淆（iO）与单向函数（OWF）的结合为构建大量密码学原语提供了强大的基础。然而，这种组合面临由Asharov和Segev（FOCS '15）建立的已知黑盒障碍，该障碍证明了构造碰撞抵抗哈希（CRH）函数的不可能性。Asharov-Segev障碍自然扩展到那些蕴含CRH的更强大的原语，例如全同态加密（FHE）和某处可提取的非交互批量论证（seBARG）。这项工作研究了iO和可重随机化原语在构造此类“CRH困难”原语中的力量。首先，我们展示了从iO和可重随机化OWF构建CRH的第一种直接且简单的方法。先前唯一已知的构造归功于Arnon、Ben-David和Yogev（CRYPTO '25），并且需要经过Waters和Wu（STOC 24'）的自适应可靠SNARG的构造。使用同样的方法，我们还从iO和可重随机化承诺构造了一个比CRH严格更强的原语，我们称之为完全可分区哈希（PPH）。其次，我们展示了可重随机化在构建高级非交互证明系统中的力量。使用iO和可重随机化承诺，我们提供了具有统计可提取性的seBARG构造，这是大多数现有seBARG方案未达到的安全属性。通过额外依赖于速率-1全同态加密，我们构造了第一个具有统计可提取性的速率-1 seBARG。在此过程中，我们引入了一种“有时统计可靠”的SNARG，并从iO和可重随机化承诺构造了它。

papers.title: Faster Post-Quantum zkSNARK Provers Using the LCH Polynomial Basis
papers.abstract: Univariate-polynomial interactive oracle proofs (IOPs) over binary extension fields $\mathbb{F}_{2^m}$ underpin a class of plausibly post-quantum zkSNARKs, but rely heavily on polynomial arithmetic, where large-domain evaluation and division by subspace vanishing polynomials are the dominant prover costs. General-basis additive FFTs, such as Gao--Mateer and Lin-Chung-Han (LCH), accelerate the evaluation but impose a basis-conversion stage costing $O(n (\log n)^2)$ field additions and $O(n \log n)$ field multiplications that dominates in practice. To eliminate basis conversion entirely, we introduce a divide-and-conquer algorithm for polynomial division by vanishing polynomials that operates directly in the LCH polynomial basis, for arbitrary $\mathbb{F}_2$-basis elements, achieving optimal $O(n \log n)$ complexity. In the LCH polynomial basis, multiplying a vanishing polynomial by the random blinding polynomial reduces to appending random field elements, eliminating the multiplication entirely. We integrate native LCH-basis arithmetic and auxiliary optimizations across all phases of the Aurora IOP. Benchmarks on Preon (a NIST PQC Round-1 signature scheme candidate built on Aurora) show end-to-end signing speedups of $5.0\times$ for Preon-128A and $5.8\times$ for Preon-256C, with the polynomial transform alone $12.6$--$17.9\times$ faster.

papers.title: Compiling Sparse Keys for Bootstrapping FHEs: Algorithms, Hardware Acceleration, and Beyond
papers.abstract: Blind rotation is the dominant computational bottleneck in bootstrapping for bitwise FHE schemes such as TFHE. Existing constructions typically evaluate $O(n)$ sequential external products for an LWE secret of dimension $n$, incurring substantial latency and a large number of NTT/iNTT operations. In this work, we present a new framework for NTRU-based bootstrapping that reduces the sequential complexity of blind rotation for sparse binary LWE secrets. Inspired by Jain et al. (CRYPTO 2026), we use Cuckoo hashing to transform an $n$-dimensional binary LWE secret of Hamming weight $h$ into extended buckets of one-hot representation. This structured representation reduces the sequential external products from $O(n)$ to $O(h)$ in blind rotation. We also design a modulus-switching method tailored to sparse secrets. We further explore an NTT-free variant that eliminates all online NTT/iNTT operations during blind rotation while supporting gate bootstrapping with lower parallel depth, offering a potentially useful building block for hardware-friendly FHE implementations. Empirically, we achieve state-of-the-art bootstrapping performance on both CPUs and GPUs. At comparable decryption failure rates and on a single CPU thread with AVX-512, our implementation executes Boolean gate, 4-bit, and 6-bit bootstrapping in $0.83$, $1.75$, and $2.65$\,ms, outperforming TFHE-rs by $3.31\times$, $4.18\times$, and $20.47\times$, respectively. On an RTX~4090 GPU, we attain a throughput of $154{,}739$ gate bootstraps per second, corresponding to an amortized time of $6.46\,\mu\mathrm{s}$, and speedups of $86.7\times$ over our CPU result and $13.6\times$ over VeloFHE (Shen et al., TCHES 2025). As a concrete application, we develop the first NTRU-based 8-bit FHE instruction set, achieving up to over $10\times$ speedup over Trama et al. (TCHES 2025) with over $100\times$ smaller key size.

papers.title: CONTRAMEM: Learning Self-Evolving Procedural Memory from Contrasting Multi-Model Trajectories
papers.abstract: Autonomous computer-use agents are increasingly applied to long-horizon tasks requiring coordinated application calls, persistent state tracking, and verifier-sensitive writes, yet they remain prone to procedural failures: misreading application state, tool semantics, or task progress. Procedural memory promises more consistent decisions and less redundant exploration, but constructing high-quality memory without model training remains challenging. We introduce CONTRAMEM, a source-flexible, training-free framework for self-evolving procedural memory that treats same-task outcome variation as supervision: differences in correctness, efficiency, recovery, and failure modes expose outcome-relevant procedural distinctions, distilled into a compact bank of app-level Function Cards and task-level Skill Cards that evolves through localized curation rather than append-only accumulation or whole-bank rewriting. On held-out GAIA2/ARE computer-use tasks, CONTRAMEM more than doubles the success rate across the three source-model targets (26.2% to 55.3%), with consistent per-model gains (GPT-5.5: 27.5 to 61.0; Claude Sonnet 4.6: 28.0 to 52.5; DeepSeek V4 Pro: 23.0 to 52.5). The same bank transfers unchanged to the unseen Qwen3.7 Plus (18.5 to 35.5), indicating transferable procedural knowledge rather than model-specific behavior. The same construction carries over unchanged to AppWorld, beating both no memory and its own single-source self-memory variant for all three mid-tier agents on both public test splits. Under a matched trajectory budget, heterogeneous multi-model trajectories yield stronger memory than self- or same-model multi-rollout memory: the margin comes from contrastive behavioral diversity, not stronger source agents or more sampling.

papers.abstract_zh: 自主计算机使用智能体越来越多地应用于需要协调应用调用、持续状态跟踪和验证器敏感写入的长时程任务，但它们仍然容易出现程序性失败：误读应用状态、工具语义或任务进度。程序性记忆有望带来更一致的决策和更少的冗余探索，但在不进行模型训练的情况下构建高质量记忆仍然具有挑战性。我们提出CONTRAMEM，一种源灵活、无需训练的自进化程序性记忆框架，它将同任务结果差异视为监督信号：正确性、效率、恢复和失败模式上的差异揭示了与结果相关的程序性区别，并将其提炼为紧凑的应用级功能卡和任务级技能卡库，该库通过局部策展而非追加式累积或全库重写来实现进化。在保留的GAIA2/ARE计算机使用任务上，CONTRAMEM将三种源模型目标的成功率提高了一倍以上（从26.2%提高到55.3%），且各模型均有一致提升（GPT-5.5：27.5到61.0；Claude Sonnet 4.6：28.0到52.5；DeepSeek V4 Pro：23.0到52.5）。同一记忆库原封不动地迁移到未见过的Qwen3.7 Plus（18.5到35.5），表明其包含的是可迁移的程序性知识而非特定于模型的行为。同样的构建方式原封不动地迁移到AppWorld，在公开测试的两个划分上，对所有三个中端智能体均优于无记忆和其自身的单源自记忆变体。在匹配的轨迹预算下，异构多模型轨迹比自模型或多轮同模型记忆产生更强的记忆：优势来自对比性行为多样性，而非更强的源智能体或更多采样。

papers.title: Interpretable statistical feature engineering for early disruption prediction in the short pulse ADITYA tokamak
papers.abstract: Reliable early disruption prediction is critical for the safe operation and real-time control of tokamaks. However, machine learning based prediction frameworks have predominantly targeted medium and long pulse devices, with comparatively limited attention given to short pulse tokamaks where available warning time is inherently constrained. In this work, an interpretable machine learning framework is developed for feature engineering and early prediction of disruptions in the ADITYA using the initial plasma evolution information, prior to the activation of the negative converter of the ohmic transformer power supply. Statistical descriptors comprising the mean, variance, skewness, kurtosis and wavelet energy entropy are extracted from routinely available plasma diagnostics over different operation time windows. Decision tree based feature selection is employed to identify physically meaningful disruption precursors and to reduce feature dimensionality. These selected features are used to train a random forest classifier. The proposed framework achieves stable predictive performance across different analysis windows, with a maximum ROC-AUC of 0.87 for 0-35 ms and 0-40 ms windows. Comparable and in some cases improved, performance is obtained using the reduced feature set, demonstrating that the selected statistical descriptors retain the essential information required for disruption prediction. The proposed methodology provides an interpretable and computationally efficient framework for real time disruption prediction in short pulse tokamaks and establishes that carefully engineered statistical descriptors can effectively replace raw time series inputs for early disruption prediction, thereby offering a practical pathway toward real time plasma control in short pulse tokamaks similar to ADITYA and ADITYA-U.

papers.title_zh: 可解释统计特征工程用于短脉冲ADITYA托卡马克早期破裂预测
papers.abstract_zh: 可靠的早期破裂预测对于托卡马克的安全运行和实时控制至关重要。然而，基于机器学习预测框架主要针对中长脉冲装置，对短脉冲托卡马克的关注相对有限，因为这类装置可用的预警时间本质上受到限制。在本工作中，开发了一个可解释的机器学习框架，用于在欧姆变压器电源的负变换器激活之前，利用初始等离子体演化信息对ADITYA中的破裂进行特征工程和早期预测。从常规可用的等离子体诊断中提取了包含均值、方差、偏度、峰度和小波能量熵的统计描述符，覆盖不同的运行时间窗口。采用基于决策树的特征选择来识别具有物理意义的破裂前兆并降低特征维度。这些选定的特征用于训练随机森林分类器。所提出的框架在不同分析窗口上实现了稳定的预测性能，在0-35 ms和0-40 ms窗口下最大ROC-AUC为0.87。使用缩减后的特征集获得了可比的、在某些情况下甚至更好的性能，表明选定的统计描述符保留了破裂预测所需的基本信息。所提出的方法为短脉冲托卡马克中的实时破裂预测提供了一个可解释且计算高效的框架，并确立了精心设计的统计描述符可以有效替代原始时间序列输入用于早期破裂预测，从而为类似ADITYA和ADITYA-U的短脉冲托卡马克中的实时等离子体控制提供了一条实用路径。

papers.title: EA Codes Approaching Singleton Bound (with Application to Field-Agnostic SNARKs)
papers.abstract: SNARKs based on error-correcting codes require codes that simultaneously support fast encoding and large relative distance. Reed--Solomon codes achieve the optimal rate--distance tradeoff given by the Singleton bound, but their fast encoding relies on FFT-friendly fields, limiting their applicability to field-agnostic constructions. In this work, we revisit expand--accumulate (EA) codes, a simple family of linear codes that admit efficient encoding over arbitrary fields. We prove strong distance guarantees for EA codes whose sparse expansion matrix is sampled from the exact-weight ensemble. Over sufficiently large finite fields, we show that these codes achieve a rate--distance tradeoff arbitrarily close to the Singleton bound with high probability, resolving conjectures from prior work. Building on these results, we construct \textsf{Flare}, a new field-agnostic polynomial commitment scheme based on EA codes. Our construction develops an efficient IOP for the constrained relation of EA codes and combines it with code switching and random linear folding for interleaved codes. For statements of size $M$, \textsf{Flare} achieves $O(M\log M)$ prover time and $O(\log^2 M)$ proof size, improving upon the $O(\sqrt{M})$ proof size of prior constructions based on EA codes.

papers.title: Claim-Level Confidence Calibration for Reliable Decision Making with Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly support decision-making in high-stakes domains, but they often hallucinate and express confidence that is misaligned with factual correctness. Response-level confidence is a coarse signal: a single generation can mix correct and incorrect statements, so a single number is not actionable for users that must accept, reject, or verify individual pieces of information. We study claim-level confidence calibration as a decision-relevant uncertainty signal: each response is decomposed into atomic, verifiable claims, and each claim is assigned a calibrated confidence using inference-time signals from consistency across samples and self-verification. Our framework operates in closed-box settings (no logits, no fine-tuning) and applies post-hoc calibration directly at the claim level, enabling selective intervention such as evidence retrieval or human review for low-confidence claims. Across TriviaQA and TruthfulQA we evaluate seven baselines on six recent models (Llama-3.1, Mistral, Qwen2.5, DeepSeek-R1, GPT-4, GPT-4o), and show that claim-level decomposition combined with post-hoc calibration reduces expected calibration error on factual questions while exposing failure modes on adversarial false-premise questions where decision-makers most need reliable uncertainty estimates.

papers.title_zh: 面向大语言模型可靠决策的声明级置信度校准
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）在高风险领域的决策支持中应用日益广泛，但它们经常产生幻觉，且所表达的置信度与事实正确性不一致。响应级置信度是一种粗糙的信号：单次生成可能混合正确与错误的陈述，因此对于必须接受、拒绝或验证每条信息的用户而言，单一数值不具有可操作性。我们研究声明级置信度校准作为一种与决策相关的不确定性信号：每个响应被分解为原子性的、可验证的声明，并且利用样本间一致性及自我验证的推理时信号，为每条声明分配经过校准的置信度。我们的框架在黑盒设置中运行（无需logits，无需微调），并直接在声明级别应用事后校准，从而实现对低置信度声明的选择性干预，如证据检索或人工审查。在TriviaQA和TruthfulQA上，我们评估了六个近期模型（Llama-3.1、Mistral、Qwen2.5、DeepSeek-R1、GPT-4、GPT-4o）的七种基线方法，结果表明声明级分解结合事后校准能够降低事实性问题上的期望校准误差，同时在对抗性虚假前提问题上暴露出失败模式——而正是在这类问题上，决策者最需要可靠的不确定性估计。

papers.title: Functional compatibility as a determinant of persistent neural learning
papers.abstract: Artificial neural networks can acquire new capabilities but often damage existing ones when they continue to learn. This stability-plasticity problem has motivated replay, regularization and constrained-update methods, yet it remains unclear whether a property of incoming learning itself determines what can be retained without disrupting protected behaviour. Here we show that functional compatibility, the extent to which new learning can coexist with behaviour that must be preserved, is a causal determinant of persistent learning. To our knowledge, this is the first controlled causal demonstration in which compatibility is deliberately changed from matched neural states and persistent learning is measured under a common retention requirement. The effect generalizes across independent learning directions, convolutional and transformer architectures, vision and text, and additional seeds. Learning rules differ in how efficiently they exploit available compatibility, while retention constraints limit how much can be stored. At larger finite updates, nonlinear geometry changes the available learning opportunity and ultimately prevents the matched compatibility continuum from being realized. These results establish functional compatibility as an experimentally controllable principle of persistent neural learning, shifting the problem from preventing forgetting towards identifying which components of new learning can safely become permanent.

papers.title_zh: 功能兼容性作为持久神经学习的决定因素
papers.abstract_zh: 人工神经网络可以获得新能力，但在继续学习时往往会破坏已有能力。这一稳定性-可塑性困境推动了回放、正则化和约束更新等方法的发展，但尚不清楚输入学习本身的某种属性是否决定了在不破坏受保护行为的前提下哪些内容可以被保留。在这里，我们表明功能兼容性——新学习与必须保留的行为能够共存的程度——是持久学习的因果决定因素。据我们所知，这是首次受控因果演示，其中兼容性被刻意地从匹配的神经状态出发加以改变，并在共同的保持要求下测量持久学习。该效应在独立学习方向、卷积架构和Transformer架构、视觉和文本以及额外随机种子上均能推广。不同的学习规则在利用可用兼容性的效率上有所不同，而保持约束限制了可以存储的内容量。在更大的有限更新下，非线性几何改变了可用的学习机会，并最终阻止了匹配的兼容性连续体得以实现。这些结果确立了功能兼容性作为持久神经学习的一个实验可控制原则，将问题从防止遗忘转向识别新学习中的哪些组成部分可以安全地变为永久性的。

papers.title: Figurative Justice: Detecting metaphors in Hindi judgements with qualitative assessment and transformers
papers.abstract: Metaphors are figurative use of words for conceptual mapping. Metaphor detection in the legal context has been crucial as metaphors are persuasive juridical means of creating legal meaning and concepts resulting in significant consequences. Metaphorical framing in legal discourse by judges, lawyers, and legislators brings about real-time implications upon individuals and influences judicial decision-making, argumentation and interpretation of laws. This is crucial in Human Rights infringement cases where language determines severity of punishment, public perception and judicial outcomes. While automatic metaphor detection in major languages like English, Spanish, Polish, Lithuanian have aided in understanding inherent intentions of metaphorical use of language, there is no such attempt in low-resource languages like Hindi. The dearth of annotated legal corpora in Hindi makes it difficult to develop NLP models and detect metaphors in judicial proceedings. In the Indian context, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have been used for classification of bail judgements, however there are no existing models designed for metaphor detection. We present a Hindi Legal Metaphor Corpus (HiLeMe) by isolating judgements from Hindi Legal Data Corpus (HLDC). Legal experts annotated HiLeMe to classify metaphorical constructions using the MIPVU schema. We downstreamed an mBERT on Hindi legal metaphor detection task. We built a transformer-based architecture for metaphor detection that are known to outperform traditional models in legal classification tasks. This model provides insights into the judicial psyche for decoding judicial decisions. Our research contributes to advancing automated models in legal discourse in low-resource languages like Hindi and envisages adoption into 22 Indian schedule languages.
